tei:div.tei:p: (ka)༄༅/ /rje bla ma kun mkhyen chen po'i bka' 'bum gyi po ti thog ma'i skabs las bstod tshogs kyi skor rnams bzhugs pa lags so// dpal ldan bla ma rin chen 'byung ldan la gsol ba 'debs pa bsod nams rab rgyas zhes bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das rin chen 'byung ldan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phun tshogs dngos grub kun gyi rin chen gter/ /rmad byung byin rlabs chu bo 'byung ba'i gzhi/ /bsam yas phrin las rlabs phreng dang ldan pa/ /yon tan rgya mtsho rje btsun bla ma rgyal/ /chos nyid mi 'gyur bai ḍūr sa gzhi'i dbus/ /dngos grub sna tshogs stsol ba'i rin chen khri/ /'khor ba'i skyon gyis ma gos 'dab stong rtser/ /shes rab thabs kyi rang bzhin nyi zla'i steng / /yon tan ngo bo rin chen 'byung ldan dang / /dbyer med rje btsun bla ma dam pa ni/ /gser bzang 'bar ba'i mdog can brjid pa'i sku/ /gdul bya'i dpal 'byor rgyas mdzad la phyag 'tshal/ /zung 'jug stong dang gsal ba rnam dag pa'i/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas pa mchog sbyin gyis/ /'gro ba'i re 'dod skong zhing phyag g.yon ni/ /mnyam bzhag ting 'dzin rgyas mdzad la phyag 'tshal/ /thabs shes zung 'jug zhabs gnyis skyil krung bzhugs/ /dngos grub mchog stsol mtshan dpe bzang po dang / /gnas skabs dgos 'dod stsol ba'i rin chen gyi/ /rgyan bzang du mas sgeg la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /'od zer bye ba'i 'phro 'dus brgyan pa'i sku/ /yan lag drug cu'i dbyangs dang ldan pa'i gsung / /dpag yas mkhyen brtse zung du 'jug pa'i thugs/ /bla ma'i sku gsung thugs la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /rnam grol lam ston brgyud pa'i bla ma dang / /rnam dag chos dbyings kun khyab yi dam lha/ /rnam mang 'gro ba'i skyabs gnas mchog gsum la/ /rnam dkar dad pa'i yid kyis bdag phyag 'tshal/ /phyi nang gsang ba bla na med pa yi/ /mchod sprin rgya mtshos rtag tu mchod par bgyi/ /sgo gsum bsags pa'i nyes kun so sor bshags/

/dus gsum dge ba kun la rjes yi rang / /zab yangs chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul/ /rtag tu mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs par gsol/ /bdag dang gzhan gyis dge ba ci bsags pa/ /mkha' mnyam 'gro bas byang chub thob phyir bsngo/ /zhing khams rnam dag gser gyi sa gzhi 'dir/ /dbus kyi ri rgyal rin chen gzhi las grub/ /gling bzhi gling phran rin chen ri bo dang / /dpag bsam shing dang ba mchog ma rmos lo/ /rgyal srid sna bdun gter gyi bum pa che/ /sgeg sogs lha mos mchod rdzas du ma 'dzin/ /nyi ma zla ba gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang / /bla re ba dan rnar snyan rol mo'i tshogs/ /rin chen rgyan dang khang brtsegs gos bzang dang / /sna tshogs 'bru bzang bza' btung sbyar legs sogs/ /lha mi'i yo byad phun tshogs kyis bkang ste/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kun khyab cing 'khor ba'i mtha'/ /rnam par gnas pa de srid rgyun mi chad/ /gzhan yang bdag gi lus dang longs spyod dang / /dus gsum dge ba'i dngos po ci mchis rnams/ /yon gnas dam pa rje btsun chos kyi rje/ /brgyud par bcas dang yi dam lha yi tshogs/ /rgyal ba sras dang bcas la dbul bar bgyi/ /dmigs med thugs rje'i dbang gis bzhes nas kyang / /bdag dang 'gro la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /deng nas bzung ste byang chub ma thob bar/ /bdag dang mkha' mnyam 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /skyabs mchog mtshungs med khyod la gsol 'debs kyis/ /tshad med mkhyen brtse'i thugs kyis dgongs su gsol/ /srid pa'i rgya mtsho che las rab bsgral nas/ /myang 'das thar pa'i skam sar 'jog tu gsol/ /bag chags mthug po'i tshang tshing bsregs nas kyang / /yang dag ye shes snang ba bskyed du gsol/ /rnam rtog rlung dmar 'tshubs mas dkrugs pa yi/ /nyon mongs rba rlabs zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ /shugs drag las kyi chu bos sdug bsngal gyi/ /chu srin kha ru khrid las bzlog tu gsol/ /byams dang snying rje'i rtsa ba rab brtan pa'i/

/byang chub sems kyi ljon shing bskyed du gsol/ /lus ngag yid la smin byed dbang bzhi yis/ /rnam grol sku bzhi'i sa bon gdab tu gsol/ /de tshe thob pa'i dam tshig sdom pa la/ /nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs rnams bzlog tu gsol/ /dbang gis mtshon pa'i yang dag lta ba yis/ /bden gnyis zung 'jug rtogs par mdzad du gsol/ /rim gnyis rnal 'byor rgyun chad med pa yis/ /tshogs gnyis zung 'jug rdzogs par mdzad du gsol/ /spyod pas bogs dbyung nye rgyus mtshams sbyar nas/ /sku bzhi mngon du 'gyur bar mdzad du gsol/ /de ma thob kyi gnas skabs kun du yang / /byang chub bsgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen bzlog tu gsol/ /mthun pa'i rkyen gyur bshes gnyen grogs mchog dang / /ma nor dam chos rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ /'tshe med gnas dang sdig med yo byad dang / /nad med tshe yi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /rnam dpyod spobs pa gzungs dang ting 'dzin sogs/ /yon tan du ma'i dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /snyan pa'i grags pas chos mthun 'khor bsdus nas/ /'gro kun rtag tu 'dun par mdzad du gsol/ /de dag skyon med khrims la legs sbyar nas/ /thos bsam sgrub pa 'phel bar mdzad du gsol/ /rtag tu 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i bya ba yis/ /thub bstan phyogs bcur rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ /rgyal khams kun tu nyer 'tshe rab zhi nas/ /dpal 'byor phun tshogs rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ /mdor na rdzogs pa'i byang chub bsgrub pa yi/ /'gal rkyen bar chad mtha' dag nyer zhi zhing / /mthun rkyen ji ltar bsams pa'i don rnams kun/ /'bad med lhun gyis grub par mdzad du gsol/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi yon tan gcig bsdus pa'i/ /rin chen 'byung ldan nyid du bdag gyur nas/ /mkha' mnyam 'gro ba'i re 'dod skong ba yis/ /bsod nams chen po rdzogs par mdzad du gsol/ /ci ltar snang ba 'di dag rang gi sems/ /sems nyid gsal dang stong pa zung 'jug tu/

/legs par rtogs nas rtse gcig bsgoms pa yis/ /ye shes tshogs chen rdzogs par mdzad du gsol/ /dpal ldan bla ma rin chen 'byung ldan la gsol ba 'debs pa bsod nams rab rgyas zhes bya ba 'di ni rje btsun bla ma rnams kyi bran du gyur pa bsod nams seng ges me pho khyi'i lo tha skar zla ba'i tshes bco lnga la dpal byams chen gyi chos grwa chen por sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni sde snod 'dzin pa bsod nams lha dbang dpal 'byor gyis bgyis so/ /'dis sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la chos dang dpal 'byor rgyas par gyur cig/ //shu bhaṃ// // ༄༅/ /rje btsun bla ma kun dga' bzang po la bstod pa/ bstod dbyangs rgya mtsho rnam par rol pa zhes bya ba/ mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshul khrims rgyan gyis kun nas mdzes pa'i sku/ /tshangs dbyangs ltar snyan dga' ba bskyed pa'i gsung / /mi rtog ting 'dzin bzang po'i thugs mnga' ba/ /'gro ba'i bla ma chos kyi rgya mtsho la/ /rab mnyen lag pa'i sor mo snying gar zum/ /rab snyan ngag gis sgra dbyangs cher sgrogs shing / /rab dang sems kyis yon tan rjes dran de/ /rab tu bstod la mkhyen brtse'i thugs kyis dgongs/ /khyod kyi yon tan dpag yas rgyal ba dang / /rgyal sras rnams kyis rab brjod de lta na'ang / /nyin byed dbang po mkha' la rgyu'o zhes/ /bung ba gshog rtse spyod pa'ang 'dor ram ci/ /blo gros rgya mtsho'i dbus na mngon mtho zhing / /rnam dag bslab gsum gser gyi rwa bas bskor/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i bang rim phreng ba can/ /rje btsun ri dbang che la bdag cag dad/ /rgyud sde'i rin chen las grub lhun po'i spor/ /rim gnyis bdud rtsi'i zas la rtag rol cing / /man ngag gling bzhir lta ba'i mig stong can/ /rig 'dzin lha yi dbang po de la 'dud/ /phul byung mkhyen pa thub bstan gsal ba'i 'od/ /thugs rje dag pa'i mkha' la rnam rol zhing /

/dpag yas dge legs lo thog smin mdzad pa/ /dam chos smra ba'i nyi ma de la 'dud/ /khyod kyi blo gros shes bya la/ /thogs med 'jug pa de yi dpe/ /gzur gnas blo yis dus kun tu/ /rnam par btsal tshe 'di ltar rnyed/ /skyes stobs sbyangs pa'i mthu ldan pas/ /zab dang gsal dang rgya che'i phyir/ /rgya mtsho nyi ma nam mkha' ni/ /phyogs tsam mtshon pa'i dpe ru mthong / /mu mtha' med pa'i shes bya la/ /chags thogs med par 'jug pa'i phyir/ /'jam dpal dbyangs kyi mkhyen pa ni/ /ma lus mtshon pa'i dpe ru mthong / /kun mkhyen gsung la mkhyen pa rab rgyas kun la brtse ba'i thugs mnga' kun rtog ma lus 'joms/ /dga' ba'i 'byung gnas rlung sems rdzing bur dga' bzhi'i 'gros kyis dga' mgur rtse bar byed pa can/ /smon lam bzang pos bskal par legs bsgrubs brtul zhugs bzang pos gdul bya skal ba bzang po'i dpe la sbyor/ /mtha' yas mkhyen brtse'i gter mnga' brtse chen khyod la snying nas 'dud do brtse ba'i lcags kyus zung / /rab 'byams shes bya'i nam mkha' yangs pa la/ /rab gsal blo gros dkyil 'khor rab rgyas te/ /rab tu brtson pa'i rta bdun gyis drangs nas/ /rab rib ma lus sel bar byed pa 'di/ /ngo mtshar las kyang 'di ni ngo mtshar zhes/ /ri bdun gser gyi me tog rab bkra zhing / /mtsho brgyad mchod yon phreng ba 'khrigs pa 'dis/ /rgyun du mchod pa'i khyad par bkod pa 'dra/ /snyigs dus 'gro ba'i dpal du su 'gyur zhes/ /spyan ras gzigs mgon thugs rje'i dbang phyug gis/ /'od zer drwa bas phyogs bcu'i mun bsal te/ /stong phrag phyag tu de snyed spyan sprul nas/ /mi mjed zhing 'dir gzigs tshe mgon khyod kyis/ /bstan la ston pa'i bya ba byed mthong nas/ /thub pa bzhin du 'di ni bkur 'os zhes/ /'dzum pa'i bzhin dang thal mo sbyar ba 'dra/ /gang sku tshul khrims 'dab ma 'bum ldan zhing /

/zhi zhing dul ba'i ge sar mdzes gsal bas/ /sdom gsum sbrang rtsi'i ro mchog myang ba'i phyir/ /don gnyer bung ba sprin gyi tshogs bzhin 'du/ /de tshe mkha' la rol ba'i lha rnams kyis/ /mchod 'os 'di la mchod pa bya'o zhes/ /bkod legs nyin byed 'od zer lhab lhub can/ /mdzes pa'i gdugs mchog g.yas su bskor ba 'dra/ /kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i go 'phang mchog brnyes kyang / /dga' bde'i 'byung gnas bstan pa spel ba'i phyir/ /thugs rje bzang pos mi yi gzugs 'dzin pa/ /khyod la bsams pa dag pas bdag skyabs 'chi/ /gang sku mdangs gsal dran pas ba spu g.yo/ /gang gsung rnar snyan dran pas mchi ma lhung / /gang thugs mkhyen bzang dran pas dran pa stor/ /nyam thag bdag la thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /gang las thob pa'i sdom gsum nor gyi mchog /gang yang bdag blo'i mdzod du sbas pa rnams/ /gang gi mkhyen brtse'i lcags kyis rab bsdoms nas/ /gang zhig byang chub bar du gnas par mdzod/ /rab dkar bsod nams gangs ri mthon po'i spor/ /dri med lung gi nga ro cher bsgrags te/ /smra ngan wa tshogs zhum zhing blo gsal gyi/ /ri dwags skyong ba'i seng ger 'gyur bar mdzod/ /ston pa bder gshegs chos kyi dbyings su bzhugs/ /bstan pa nyin byed nub rir son dus 'dir/ /bstan 'dzin khyod kyis zhing 'di spong ba'i phyir/ /bstan la sems pa min snyam the tshom gyur/ /'on kyang 'dul 'os gdul bya smin mdzad nas/ /slar yang spros bral chos skur bzhugs pa ni/ /rgyal ba kun gyi ngang tshul yin pas na/ /bdag gis 'khang pa'ang rgyu mtshan ci zhig yod/ /dpag med bskal par bzhugs pa'i mthu ldan zhing / /thub bstan sprin bzhin dengs par rab mkhyen kyang / /zhing 'di spangs nas zhing gzhan gshegs pa ni/ /mkhyen bzang khyod la brtse ba med snyam sems/ /'on kyang dkon mchog go 'phang mchog brnyes nas/ /thub bstan gser gyi rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa de/

/brtse chen khyod kyi thugs las sprul pa'i phyir/ /tshad med thugs rje'i bka' drin lhag par dran/ /de ltar bstod pa'i rnam dkar dge ba des/ /nam zhig tshe 'di'i snang ba nub ma thag /'gro mgon khyod kyi zhing bzang der skyes nas/ /'jam dbyangs bla ma'i zhal mchog mthong bar shog /der yang dges pa chen pos rjes bzung ste/ /dkyil 'khor bzhi la dbang bzhi'i char phab nas/ /yang dag lam bzang bzhi yis grol byas te/ /sku bzhi'i go 'phang mngon du 'gyur bar shog /'bras bu mchog de ma thob de srid du/ /khyod sku mtshan dpe kunam̐ ldan blta ba dang / /de'i gsung legs bshad dgam̐' ston rtag nyan cing / /gang thugs mkhyen brtse bzam̐ng pom̐s skyong bar shog /rgyu rgyud rang bzhin rnam dag lcags kyi khams/ /thabs rgyud nus ldan rtsi yis zin pa yis/ /'bras rgyud gser gyi phung por bsgyur ba yi/ /gdams pa'i rgyal pos bdag rgyud gtams par shog /bla chen khyod kyi thugs rje'i gzi 'od dang / /skyabs mchog rin chen gsum gyi byin rlabs dang / /dpal mgon srung ma rnams kyi nus mthu yis/ /bdag gi smon lam 'di rnams 'grub gyur cig /de ltar bstod 'di bstod yul de nyid la/ /dad dang bsom̐d namam̐s lus stobs rab rgyas nas/ /des bstan gzhung lugs ral pa'i khur gyis brjid/ /de'i gsung smra ba'i sem̐ng gem̐ gang de'o/ /bhri ha ti dang rab dga' bstan 'dzin dang / /slar yang bhri ha ti yis rim bzhin du/ /dus me zla ba mkha' lag bsdebs pa 'di/ /khyu mchog gong gi tsand+ra mkha' zlar sbyar// ༈ //rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po la bstod pa// ༄༅/ /na mo gu ra we/ lhar bcas 'gro ba kunam̐ gyi cod paṇa gyis/ /gang gi zhabs pad dgam̐' bas rtag bsten cing / /dad pa bzam̐ng po'im̐ yid kyis gus btud pa/ /skyabs mchog 'jam dpal bla ma de la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas kunam̐ gyi mkhyen brtse gcig bsdus nas/

/dam chos kunam̐ gyi sgra dbyangs snyan pa'i gsung / /dge 'dun kunam̐ gyi dbus su cher sgrogs pas/ /skal ldan kunam̐ gyi 'dren par gyur la 'dud/ /bde chen dgam̐' bzhi'i dkyil 'khor las byung ba'i/ /legs bshad dgam̐' ston bye ba'i tsha zer gyis/ /mkhas rnams dgam̐' ba'i zab don rab gsal zhing / /phan bde'i dgam̐' tshal rgyas par mdzad la 'dud/ /blo gros bzam̐ng pos shes bya'i de nyid gzigs/ /thugs rje bzam̐ng pom̐s 'gro kun rjes su 'dzin/ /phrin las bzam̐ng pom̐s thub bstan rgyas mdzad pa/ /dngos grub bzam̐ng pom̐'i gter chen de la 'dud/ /rnam pa kunam̐ tu dgam̐' zhing dwang ba'i blos/ /'dren mchog bzam̐ng po khyod la gsol 'debs kyi/ /thog med bsags pa'i sdig sgrib kun sbyangs nas/ /rim gnyis zab mo'i rtogs pa bskyed du gsol/ /gnas skabs kunam̐ tu khyod nyid bzhed pa yi/ /phrin las dgam̐' zhing spro bas bsgrub pa la/ /mthun rkyen bzam̐ng pom̐ de dag phun tshogs shing / /mi mthun phyogs kun zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ /gang la bstod cing gsol ba btab pa dang / /gzhan yang dus gsum bsags pa'i bsod nams kun/ /mkha' mnyam 'gro ba kun dang thun mong du/ /shākya seng ge'i gong 'phang thob phyir bsngo/ /ces rgyal ba khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang dang dbyer ma mchis pa rje btsun kun dga' bzang po la bstod cing gsol ba gdab pa'i rab du byed pa 'di ni rje de nyid kyi zhabs rdul spyi bos len pa dge slong bsod nams seng ges gling kha bde ba can du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rab mchog rgyal po'o// // ༄༅/ /rje btsun bla ma mus pa chen po'i rnam par thar pa ngo mtshar chu rgyun ces bya ba/ rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dkon mchog mkhyen pa'i gter chen 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /rgyal ba'i thugs rje gcig bsdus spyan ras gzigs/ /mtshan mchog lta bas mi ngom rdo rje 'dzin/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal nas/

/skyes chen dam pa'i rnam thar rgya mtsho las/ /cha tsam dad pa'i snyim pas legs bcus nas/ /bdag blo tshim zhing dad ldan gzhan la yang / /dad pa'i chu rgyun spel phyir sbyin par bya/ /rgya chen smon lam dag pa'i dri bzhon gyis/ /dpag yas tshogs gnyis chu gter bsrubs pa las/ /bstan pa gser ri'i dbus su dar 'byor gyi/ /sa 'dzin dkar po brnyes pa de la 'dud/ /gzhon nu nyid nas srid pa'i phun tshogs la/ /zhen pa spangs shing sngon sbyangs bag chags kyis/ /gtan gyi bde ba thob byed dam pa'i chos/ /rgyun chad med par bsgrub par bzhed la 'dud/ /bstan la 'jug tshe dbang 'od bzang po yis/ /rnam dag tshul khrims bslab pa'i khang bzang du/ /thabs shes dbyer med kye yi rdo rje yi/ /smin byed nor gyis gtams par mdzad la 'dud/ /thos pa rgya mtsho'i gling du 'jug pa'i tshe/ /sangs rgyas blo gros thugs rje dpal sogs las/ /lung dang rigs pa'i gzhung lugs legs sbyangs nas/ /blo gsal 'dus pa'i rgyan du gyur la 'dud/ /'dzam gling mkhas pa'i dbang po sangs rgyas dpal/ /de sras thu bo rong ston chos rje sogs/ /mtshungs bral yongs 'dzin mang po nyer bsten nas/ /thos pa rgya mtsho'i pha rol son la 'dud/ /gzhon nu'i sar gnas rgyal sras mchog gyur las/ /dbu tshad rigs pa'i rnam bzhag ma lus dang / /byams chos 'dul mngon la sogs thugs chud nas/ /sde snod kun gyi gter du gyur la 'dud/ /dpal ldan a ti sha yi gdams pa'i bcud/ /byang chub sems gnyis sbyong ba'i man ngag gi /bka' babs ji snyed kun la dbang 'byor bas/ /byang chub thugs kyi bdag por gyur la 'dud/ /mnyam med nam mkha'i rnal 'byor zhabs drung du/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro ne gu'i gdams pa dang / /nā ro chos drug phyag chen gcod la sogs/ /gdams pa bdud rtsis tshim par mdzad la 'dud/ /theg chen chos rje brtse ldan bka' lnga pa/ /kun dga' bla ma yon tan dpal la sogs/

/bcu phrag bzhi yi bla ma nyer bsten nas/ /gsung rab kun gyi mdzod du gyur la 'dud/ /rab 'byams smra ba'i dbang po kun dga' dpal/ /sems dpa' don rin dar ma rin chen las/ /bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i sdom pa legs mnos nas/ /ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i mchog tu gyur la 'dud/ /gsang chen rgyud sde'i gdams pa don gnyer tshe/ /'jam dbyangs bla ma kun dga' bzang po yi/ /ngo mtshar rnam thar thos pas yid g.yos te/ /g.yo ba med par de drung bsnyen la 'dud/ /bla ma mchog las rnam dag dbang nos nas/ /kyai rdor rgyud gsum dpal ldan 'dus pa dang / /khyad par 'khor lo bde mchog gsang mtha' yi/ /rgyud lung man ngag rdzogs par mnos la 'dud/ /gang tshe gsang mtha'i gdams pas yid tshim nas/ /sgrub la gzhol tshe 'dren mchog bzang po yis/ /ma 'ongs skye rgu'i mgon du gzigs gyur nas/ /gsung ngag snod du nan gyis bskul la 'dud/ /khyod blo dag pa'i rin chen bum bzang du/ /gdams pa'i chu rgyun rdzogs par ma gtams pa/ /de srid bstan pa'i bya ba ma rdzogs zhes/ /mgon des brtson pas skyong ba khyod la 'dud/ /de tshe gzhir gnas dkyil 'khor rnam bzhi la/ /dbang bzhi thob cing lam bzang bzhi bsgoms pas/ /lta ba bzhi dang grub mtha' bzhi 'dren pa'i/ /snyan brgyud bzhi yi gdams pa thebs la 'dud/ /ring brgyud tshad ma bzhi la drug phrag bcu/ /man ngag phran tshegs bcas dang nye brgyud gnyis/ /rnam 'grel rgyas sogs rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi /gdams pa rgya mtshos khyod thugs gang la 'dud/ /gzhan yang rgyud sde rnam bzhi'i dbang dang lung / /rjes gnang rig gtad man ngag lag len bcas/ /rgya bod mkhas pa'i legs bshad rnams la sogs/ /dpag yas chos kyi bka' drin mnos la 'dud/ /rgya chen thos pas sgro 'dogs legs chod cing / /dbang lung man ngag nor gyis rgyud phyug nas/ /sna tshogs spros pa'i bya ba kun spangs te/ /dben pa'i gnas su rtse cig bsgrubs la 'dud/

/dben gnas dngul chur mtha' bral don bsgom tshe/ /snod bcud dngul chu'i rgya mtsho ji bzhin du/ /rnam par g.yo zhing thogs med 'jug pa yi/ /nyams myong mngon du mdzad pa de la 'dud/ /rgyun chad med par snying rje'i chu rgyun gyis/ /grangs med 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal rtag bsal zhing / /bde dge'i sprin tshogs nam mkha' kun bkang nas/ /ma rnams kun la sbyin par mdzad la 'dud/ /byams dang snying rje byang chub sems bsgom tshe/ /mgon med skrag pa'i yid ldan ri dwags tshogs/ /ma la bu bzhin khyod skur gus btud nas/ /rig rig mig gis khyod zhal blta la 'dud/ /las kyis dgra zlar gyur pa'i gna' khyi yang / /mgon po gang gi zhabs drung bsten pa'i mthus/ /'bral mi phod pa'i byams sems ldan pa sogs/ /rmad byung ngo mtshar bsam las 'das la 'dud/ /de slad theg chen dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis/ /byang chub sems kyi bdag por dbang bskur nas/ /rgyun chad med par 'gro la spel zhes pa'i/ /lung bstan dbugs dbyung mdzad pa khyod la 'dud/ /dbang gis mtshon pa'i yang dag lta ba'i don/ /gsal stong zung 'jug brjod bral lhan cig skyes/ /nyams len kun la khyab par legs bsgoms pas/ /'khrul snang ye shes chen por shar la 'dud/ /cho ga gsum dang sa bon sgra tshul dang / /mnyam dang mi mnyam sbyor ba'i mngon byang lngas/ /tha mal snang ba ye shes lngar bsgoms pas/ /cir snang lha yi 'khor lor shar la 'dud/ /'khor lo lnga dang nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i gnas/ /tshigs chen rnams dang dbang po'i rtsa thig rnams/ /gdan gsum tshang ba'i lha ru legs bsgoms pas/ /rlung sems mkha' 'gros byin gyis brlabs la 'dud/ /rtsa rlung thig le'i rnal 'byor dam pa dang / /rdo rje lus kyi 'khrul 'khor la sogs kyis/ /gzung 'dzin rlung sems dbu mar rab bcug nas/ /bde stong mchog gi ye shes brnyes la 'dud/ /bsgom pa'i stobs kyis lus la bde drod 'bar/

/sems la sna tshogs nyams kyi snang ba shar/ /gzhan sems mngon du gyur pa'i mtshan ma sogs/ /dad ldan slob mas nges par gyur la 'dud/ /'khor lo bde mchog 'jam dbyangs gshin rje'i gshed/ /ma hā kā la spyan ras gzigs sogs kyi/ /gsang sngags bye ba du ma rab bzlas pas/ /dngos grub rnam gnyis lhun gyis grub la 'dud/ /khyad par bde stong dbyer med kye rdo rje'i/ /rtsa sngags 'bum phrag bcu gsum bzlas pa'i tshe/ /dam pa brgyud pa'i dbang gi chu bo rnams/ /bdag nyid dbang gi mtshan ma mthong la 'dud/ /thun mtshams kun tu mchod gtor rnal 'byor dang / /mdo rgyud klog dang sbyin sreg mchod rten las/ /skal ldan 'ga' la zab lam 'chad pa sogs/ /rnam dkar dge bas 'da' bar mdzad la 'dud/ /bza' ba bdud rtsis rang lus yi dam mchod/ /mnal tshe 'od gsal stong pa'i ngang la 'jog /ldang tshe zung 'jug gzugs kyi skur bzhengs nas/ /snod bcud dag pa'i snang bar bltas la 'dud/ /ting grol gnas su rnal 'byor ma zhig gis/ /gser las byas pa'i rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi gzugs/ /rnam par gtad nas sa skya paṇḍi ta'i/ /bstan pa spel zhes lung bstan brnyes la 'dud/ /mtshungs pa dang bral 'jig rten mgon po'i gzugs/ /dngos su gzigs nas skal ldan 'ga' zhig gis/ /khyod nyid 'jig rten mgon por gnas pa la/ /de nyid du mas btud pa mthong la 'dud/ /dben gnas mchog tu bsam gtan bsgrubs pa'i tshe/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug rje btsun sa skya pas/ /byin gyis brlabs shing dpag med 'gro ba yi/ /don mchog bsgrub pa'i rten 'brel bsgrigs la 'dud/ /'dren pa mchog gis skal ldan khyod nyid la/ /bstan pa rgya mtsho ma gtad de srid du/ /brtan par bzhugs nas nam zhig mngon gyur tshe/ /rgyal tshab chen por dbang bskur mdzad la 'dud/ /bla ma nyid kyis ngur smrig rgyal mtshan dang / /dam tshig mchog gi rdo rje dril bu dang /

/dpal ldan brtse ba chen po'i bris sku rnams/ /bstan pa'i rgyun dang mnyam du gtad la 'dud/ /dam tshig sdom la nyes pa med slad dang / /lhag pa'i lha dang dbyer med 'du shes kyis/ /slar yang blo chen de yi thugs dgongs rnams/ /legs bsgrubs lhun gyis grub pa de la 'dud/ /bla ma nyid dang shākya seng ge'i sku/ /dam pa brgyud pa'i gsung rab rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /rgyal mtshan ltar grags chos sku'i rten mchog rnams/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rten du bsgrubs la 'dud/ /'jam dbyangs bla ma'i sku gdung ring bsrel rnams/ /gser sogs rin chen gyis spras mchod rten ni/ /stong phrag bdun cur bsgrubs nas phyogs bcu yi/ /dad ldan mchod pa'i rten du sbyin la 'dud/ /bla ma mchog gi bzhed pa bsgrub slad dang / /grangs med 'gro la phan bde skrun pa'i phyir/ /dam chos bdud rtsi'i char gyis dus kun tu/ /phan bde'i lo thog skrun par mdzad la 'dud/ /legs gsung 'dul ba'i bslab pa don gnyer rnams/ /dge bsnyen dge tshul dge slong sdom pa la/ /skal bzhin dri med cho gas legs bkod pas/ /kun gyi gnas brtan chen por gyur la 'dud/ /a ti sha yi gdams pa'i nyi 'od kyis/ /byams dang snying rje'i pad mo kha 'byed cing / /byang sems bslab pa sbrang rtsi'i bcud gtams nas/ /skal bzang bung ba'i dga' ston spel la 'dud/ /thun mong lam gyis sbyangs pa'i slob ma rnams/ /gdan gsum tshang ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po ru/ /brgyud par ldan pa'i cho gas dbang bskur bas/ /sku bzhi'i sa bon thebs par mdzad la 'dud/ /rgyud sde rgya mtshor rnam dpyod gru gzings bcas/ /mtha' drug tshul bzhi'i rlung dar rab bskyod nas/ /zab don yid bzhin nor bu legs blangs te/ /blo ldan blo yi bang mdzod 'gengs la 'dud/ /rim pa dang po'i rnal 'byor 'chad pa'i tshe/ /rtog ge 'khrul ba'i drwa ba kun bsal nas/

/ma dag 'khor ba'i phung khams skye mched rnams/ /dag pa lha yi 'khor lor ston la 'dud/ /rim bzhi rim lnga shin tu spros med dang / /sbyor ba yan lag drug sogs rdzogs rim gyis/ /skal ldan slob ma'i lhar zhen rnam rtog rnams/ /bde chen ye shes mchog tu bsgyur la 'dud/ /khyad par snyan brgyud tshad ma bzhi ldan gyis/ /gangs ri'i khrod kyi rnam grol don gnyer rnams/ /thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor mchog la legs bkod nas/ /gsang chen bstan pa rgyas par mdzad la 'dud/ /'bum phrag rgyud dang grub pa'i gzhung bzang dang / /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i legs bshad rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /sde snod dgongs 'grel bcas pa'i lung rnams kyis/ /thub bstan rgyun mi chad par mdzad la 'dud/ /de ltar dri med bstan pa spel ba'i mthus/ /'khon gyi gdung brgyud skyes chen rnams la sogs/ /rigs rus cho 'brang dpal gyis mngon mtho ba'i/ /gangs can che rgus khyod zhabs bsten la 'dud/ /gzhan yang dpag yas lung dang rigs pa la/ /dbang bsgyur mkhas pa'i dbang po mchog rnams kyis/ /khyod gsung thub pa'i gsung ltar gus bsten nas/ /brtson pas bsgrub cing phyogs bcur spel la 'dud/ /ris bsgyur phyogs ni thub par bcas pa'i tshe/ /grangs med mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i gzhir gyur pa'i/ /bza' ba'i dam tshig bdud rtsi ril bu mchog /tshul bzhin bsgrub pa mtha' ru phyin la 'dud/ /slar yang dben pa'i gnas der zab mo'i lam/ /rtse gcig bsgrub pa mdzad tshe mnal lam du/ /rje btsun bla ma mthu stobs dbang phyug gis/ /zhal mchog gzigs shing byin gyis brlabs la 'dud/ /'chad rtsod rtsom la 'gran gyi zla med cing / /chos brgyad snyoms pas 'dzin la kun dang bral/ /snyan pa'i grags pas rgya mtsho'i gos can khyab/ /rnam thar bsam mi khyab pa de la 'dud/ /srid na khyed 'dra'i skyabs gzhan 'byung ba dkon/ /rnam dag thugs ni chos brgyad dri ma med/

/nyon mongs ye shes bsgyur ba'i mthu ldan pa/ /rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkhyen pa'i ba dan 'jig rten kun gyi rgyan/ /snying rje'i gdugs dkar gdung ba skyob pa'i mchog /phrin las gser bzang rkyen gyis 'gyur ba med/ /rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs la phyags 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba kun gyi yab gcig rdo rje 'chang / /rgyal ba'i yum mchog shes rab pha rol phyin/ /rgyal sras thu bo byams mgon thugs rje can/ /rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mtshan gyis spras shing dpe byad 'bar ba'i sku/ /mtshan rtog kun 'joms sngags kyi rang bzhin gsung / /mtshan 'dzin rnam spangs rdo rje'i thugs mnga' ba/ /rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhing 'dir dkon pa'i mchod pa'i rdzas mchog rnams/ /rgyal sras kun tu bzang po'i rnam 'phrul ltar/ /mtshan med ting 'dzin ngang nas rab sprul te/ /rje btsun bla ma mnyes phyir dbul bar bgyi/ /bskyed par dkon pa'i sems mchog nyams pa sogs/ /rgyal bas bkag pa'i nyes ltung ci mchis rnams/ /mtshan dang nyin du gnong zhing 'gyod pa yis/ /rje btsun bla ma'i spyan sngar so sor bshags/ /bsgrub par dkon kyang mchog tu bde ba'i rgyu/ /rgyal dang de sras rang rgyal la sogs kyis/ /mtshan bcas mtshan med dge ba mdzad rnams la/ /dad pas bdag ni rjes su yi rang ngo / /rnyed par dkon pa'i theg mchog rdo rje'i theg /rgyal ba kun gyi gsang chen bla na med/ /mtshan rtog las skyob rim gnyis zab mo'i lam/ /rgyun chad med par 'gro la bstan du gsol/ /thos par dkon pa'i zhing mchog chos kyi rje/ /rgyal ba sras bcas dgongs pa bsgrub slad du/ /mtshan mo'i mgon dang nyin byed gnas kyi bar/ /mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs/ /bsags par dkon pa'i dge mchog ci mchis rnams/ /rgyal sras dpa' bo rnams kyis bsngo ba ltar/ /mtshan med rnam par mi rtog shes rab kyis/

/bla med byang chub mchog tu bsngo bar bgyi/ /deng nas bzung ste tshe rabs thams cad du/ /dkon mchog gsum dngos bla ma yid bzhin nor/ /'bral med dad pa'i rgyal mtshan rtser mchod nas/ /yang dag gdams pa'i dpal la spyod par shog /don med tshe 'di'i bya bas mi g.yeng bar/ /don chen sgrub byed byang chub sems mchog dang / /don dam rtogs pa'i shes rab phun tshogs rnams/ /don gzhan spangs nas rtser gcig bsgom par shog /dam tshig sdom pa rnam dag ngang ldan zhing / /dam chos snying po rim gnyis zab mo'i lam/ /dam pas bsngags pa'i gnas su legs bsgoms pas/ /dam pa'i don mchog zung 'jug rtogs par shog /dge ba 'di yis bdag gzhan 'gro ba kun/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis myur rdzogs nas/ /shākya seng ge'i go 'phang mngon gyur te/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba 'dren pa'i dpal du shog /rje btsun bla ma mus pa chen po'i rnam par thar pa ngo mtshar chu rgyun ces bya ba tshigs su bcad pa drug cu rtsa bzhi pa 'di ni/ rje de nyid kyi zhabs rdul spyi bos blangs pa phyogs med rgyal khams kyi bya bral ba bsod nams seng ges chu pho rta'i lo snron gyi zla ba'i yar tshes gcig la 'bras yul rdzong dkar gyi skyed mos tshal du sbyar ba las/ slar yang shing mo bya'i lor tshigs su bcad pa drug cig bsnan pa'o// //shu bhaṃ// // ༄/ /kha skong na mo gu ra we/ gang la yon tan mchog mnga' zhing / /nyes pa bag chags bcas spangs nas/ /gcig tu gzhan don la gzhol ba/ /mtshungs med rje btsun de la 'dud/ /gang de'i rnam thar mdo tsam zhig /ngo mtshar rgya mtshor sngar bstan zin/ /de yi kha skong thun mong du/ /grags pa 'dir ni brjod par bya/ /thugs rjes gzhan don lhur blangs nas/ /sku tshe'i 'du byed byin brlabs te/ /gya gnyis bar du gdul bya yi/ /'dren pa mdzad pa de la 'dud/ /zhing 'di'i gdul bya smin mdzad nas/ /'jig rten khams ni rnam mang du/

/sprul pa bye ba phrag brgya yis/ /grangs med 'gro ba'i don mdzad phyir/ /gzhi dus 'byung bzhi'i thim rim rnams/ /lam gyis nyams su bsgyur mdzad nas/ /rnam shes 'od gsal thim pa'i tshe/ /mchog gi dngos grub brnyes la 'dud/ /de tshe 'gyur med bde stong gi /ye shes brnyes pa'i phyi rtags su/ /bcu drug lo lon byis pa yi/ /rnam pa ji bzhin gzhon sha can/ /zhal gyi dkyil 'khor gnyer ma med/ /dkar dmar mdangs gsal 'od 'phro zhing / /spyan ni dkar gnag 'byes pa sogs/ /mtshan mchog mngon du gyur la 'dud/ /rlung sems dbu mar tshud pa'i brdar/ /nyin zhag bcu bdun 'das kyi bar/ /'phags yul grub pa'i dbang phyug gi /bzhugs stangs ji bzhin drang por bsrang / /phyag g.yas rdo rje'i khu tshur dang / /g.yon pa sdigs mdzub bsnol ba yis/ /grim shar bcas pas sku la 'khyud/ /gzi brjid mdangs ldan de la 'dud/ /byams dang snying rje'i rgyu mthun gyis/ /bya dang ri dwags tshogs rnams kyang / /gnas gzhan spangs nas de nyid du/ /bkod pa bzhin du 'khod gyur cing / /mkha' la 'ja' 'od gur chen phub/ /khor yug drod kyi rnam pa dang / /tshul khrims dag pa'i dri bzang gis/ /kun tu khyab pa de la 'dud/ /kye ma 'jig rten kun gyi mig /'gro mgon nyi ma 'das gyur nas/ /snyigs dus gdul bya'i dad pa dang / /blo gros pad mo su yis 'byed/ /khyod 'dra'i mgon dang bral ba'i tshe/ /bdag snying tshal brgyar ma gas pa/ /lcags sam rdo yi khams nyid las/ /byas pa nyid dam yang na ci/ /'on kyang rang sems dag pa 'di/ /bla ma mchog dang yi dam du/ /snang ba'i phyir na mgon khyod dang / /'bral ba med par bdag gis rtogs/ /dpe bral khyod kyi yon tan ni/ /ma lus mtshon pa'i dpe zla zhig /skyon bral mig gis rnyed dka' na/ /bdag blos btsal yang ji ltar rnyed/ /'on kyang srid na grags pa yi/ /dpe yi yon tan thams cad kyis/

/khyod kyi yon tan phyogs re yi/ /cha tsam mtshon pa 'di ltar mthong / /gang gi rnam thar mngon bsam na/ /rgyal dang rgyal sras thams cad kyi/ /rnam thar bzang po ma lus pa/ /gcig tu bsdus nas spungs pa bzhin/ /gang gi brtson pa rnam gnyis kyis/ /bla med byang chub bsgrub pa ni/ /mar me'i rtse mo rab bcings dang / /chu bo'i rgyun ni rab 'bab bzhin/ /gang gi mkhyen rab dri med kyis/ /shes bya'i gnas lugs gsal ba ni/ /sprin med nam mkhar nyi ma yi/ /dkyil 'khor shar ba ji bzhin no/ /gang gi byams dang snying rje yis/ /'gro kun bdag gir mdzad pa ni/ /sred ldan skyes bu rang nyid kyi/ /bu la byams pa ji bzhin no/ /gang gi rnam dkar phrin las kyis/ /thub bstan kun tu khyab pa ni/ /rgya mtsho'i gos can rtswa ljang gi /myu gus bres pa ji bzhin no/ /rje btsun dbang gi rgyal po gang / /dad pa'i rgyal mtshan rtser mchod na/ /dgos 'dod ma lus stsol ba ni/ /yid bzhin nor bu ji bzhin no/ /de slad bdag sogs gdul bya rnams/ /rtse gcig gus pas gsol 'debs kyis/ /dmigs med thugs rje'i spyan ras kyis/ /rnam pa kun tu gzigs su gsol/ /tshe 'dir dngos su mthong ba yi/ /skal ba med mod de lta na'ang / /rmi lam nyid du zhal bstan nas/ /the tshom drwa ba gcad du gsol/ /khyod kyi phrin las bsgrub pa la/ /'gal rkyen bar du gcod pa'i tshogs/ /phyi nang nyer 'tshe ma lus pa/ /nye bar zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ /mthun rkyen 'tshe med gnas dang ni/ /sdig med zas dang yo byad sogs/ /yid la 'dod dgu ma lus pa/ /lhun gyis grub par mdzad du gsol/ /tshe rabs kun tu mgon khyod kyis/ /tshul bzhin rjes su bzung nas kyang / /smin byed dbang gi chu bo yis/ /bdag rgyud gtams par mdzad du gsol/ /rim gnyis gdams pa zab mo yis/ /dbang las thob pa'i bskyed rdzogs kyi/ /sdom pa gong nas gong nyid du/

/'phel bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /'dus pa gsum po mthar phyin nas/ /mchog gi dngos grub thob gyur te/ /slar yang dkyil 'khor bzhi'i rten 'brel/ /rgyun du 'grig par mdzad du gsol/ /'bras dus dbang gi chu bo yis/ /'gros bzhi gtsug tor mchog nyid du/ /thim nas che ba gsum ldan pa'i/ /mthar thug 'bras bu stsal du gsol/ /mdor na mang du smos ci 'tshal/ /spang rtogs mdzad pa'i yon tan rnams/ /mthar phyin rje btsun khyod nyid dang / /rnam dbyer med par byin gyis rlobs/ /tshul 'di bsod nams seng ge yis/ /bla ma'i yon tan rjes dran nas/ /sa glang smal po'i bcu gcig la/ /gle lung chos sder legs par sbyar/ /dge ba 'di dang dge ba gzhan/ /mkha' mnyam 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /skyon med bla ma dam pa yis/ /rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /'di la the tshom dogs med par/ /nges shes gang gis skyes gyur pa/ /'dren mchog bla ma dam pa yi/ /thugs kyis rjes su 'dzin par nges// //shu bhaṃ// // ༄/ /mtshan spel gyi bstod pa rin chen dkon mchog ma bzhugs so/ /na mo ratna dhwa dzā ya/ rin chen dkon mchog gsum gyi ngo bo nyid/ /rgyal ba kun 'dus drug pa rdo rje 'chang / /mtshan tsam dran pas srid zhi'i dpal ster ba/ /dngos grub bzang po'i gter la gsol ba 'debs/ /mkhyen rab 'od kyis zab don pad tshal 'byed/ /thugs rje'i lcags kyus nyam thag 'gro ba 'dren/ /phrin las char gyis gdul bya tshim mdzad pa/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /nyes spyod 'dam bu'i tshal rnams kun tu bcom/ /gzhan phan gser gyi drwa bas gdong mdzes shing / /gsang chen gdams pa'i khur gyis mi ngal ba'i/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /yid bzhin nor 'dra'i thugs la dbang bsgyur zhing / /yang dag lta bas chos kun sgyu mar gzigs/ /yi dam lha dang bla ma'i lung bstan brnyes/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/

/khyod kyi phung khams rgyal dang rgyal ba'i yum/ /dbang sogs sems dpa' yul rnams lha mor ston/ /nyid sku'i cha shas khro bo bcur sprul pa'i/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /dus gsum rgyal ba mchod pa'i bsod nams kun/ /gang gi ba spu'i khung bu gcig nyid la/ /rnam par gnas zhes rgyal bas bden gsungs pa/ /de slad dngos po kun gyis rab tu mchod/ /rab mang nyes pa'i tshogs rnams so sor bshags/ /rab dkar dge ba kun la rjes yi rang / /rab zab chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul/ /rab 'byams 'gro ba'i don du bzhugs su gsol/ /dkon mchog gsum dngos rje btsun khyod nyid la/ /sems mchog dad pas gsol ba btab pa'i mthus/ /dge mchog bsags pa gang des 'gro ba kun/ /'dren mchog bla mas rjes su 'dzin par shog /don med tshe 'di'i bya bas mi g.yeng bar/ /don chen sgrub byed byang chub sems mchog dang / /don dam rtogs pa'i shes rab phun tshogs rnams/ /don gzhan spangs nas rtse gcig bsgom par shog /dam tshig sdom pa rnam dag dang ldan zhing / /dam chos snying po rim gnyis zab mo'i lam/ /dam pas bsngags pa'i gnas su legs bsgoms pas/ /dam pa'i don mchog zung 'jug rtogs par shog /dge ba 'di yis bdag gzhan 'gro ba kun/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis myur rdzogs nas/ /shākya seng ge'i go 'phang mngon gyur te/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba 'dren pa'i dpal du shog /ces pa 'di yang dad ldan gyis/ /bskul nas bsod nams seng ge yis/ /bde ba can du legs par sbyar/ /dge tshogs byang chub chen po bsngo// //shu bhaṃ// // ༄/ /bdag chen chu mig pa la bstod pa/ na mo gu ra we/ zab yangs blo gros dbang lung nor gyis phyug /dge legs thar pa'i 'byung gnas rin po che/ /bde gshegs bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan rtser mchod pa/ /dpal 'byor bzang po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yon tan gzhir gyur sa bcu'i rtogs pa mchog

/kha ba dung dang ku mud ltar skya ba/ /gang gis brnyes nas ma rig las 'khon pa'i/ /cho 'brang mchog tu 'khrungs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mtha' dag 'gro la brtse ba'i thugs rje dang / /gnas lugs 'khrul med rtogs pa'i blo gros kyis/ /mtha' yas gsung rab don la dbang 'byor zhing / /snyan brgyud gdams pas phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thub bstan rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang na/ /legs par bshad pa'i rnga sgra cher 'byung zhing / /blo gsal nye dbang bsti ba'i gnas gyur pa/ /mkhas mchog lha yi dbang po la phyag 'tshal/ /ngur smrig rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa kun gyi gtso/ /theg chen bslab pa'i dpal gyis rab tu brjid/ /dngos grub bzang po'i gter gyur rim gnyis kyi/ /rnal 'byor mthar phyin de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byin rlabs rgya mtsho'i dbus na gnas bcas shing / /sde snod rgyud sde'i gdengs ka bdun dang ldan/ /lhag bsam spyi bo yongs 'dzin nor bus spras/ /'dren mchog klu yi dbang po la phyag 'tshal/ /srid pa gsum gyi sems can don slad du/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi mkhyen brtse gcig bsdus nas/ /khams gsum 'gro la skye bo'i skur ston pa/ /'jam dbyangs bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de ltar bstod pa'i rnam dkar dge tshogs kyis/ /dpal ldan bla ma sku tshe rab brtan cing / /phrin las 'gro ba kun la khyab pa dang / /gdul bya'i rgyud la byin rlabs 'jug par shog /bdag kyang gsol ba 'debs pa'i don slad dang / /grags pa rgyal mtshan ngag gis bskul ba'i ngor/ /bstod tshig 'di ni bsod nams seng ge yis/ /dpal ldan u rgyan chos rdzong dgon par sbyar/ /shu bhaṃ// // ༄/ /kun dga' dbang phyug pa'i bstod pa/ na mo gu ra we/ dpal ldan kun dga'i lam bzang byed po yis/ /yongs bzung gsung rab don la dbang 'byor zhing / /snyan brgyud gdams pa'i nor gyis rgyud phyug pa/ /rgyal tshab dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkhyen rab nam mkha'i khyon ltar zab cing yangs/

/thugs rje nyi ma'i 'od ltar kun la snyoms/ /phrin las dpag bsam shing ltar gsal gyur pa/ /dge mtshan bye ba'i gter la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyams dang rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor mthar phyin cing / /nges don zab mo'i de nyid legs gzigs nas/ /skal ldan 'gro la tshul bzhin 'doms mdzad pa/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khams gsum 'gro ba srid las bsgral bya'i phyir/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam/ /sdom gsum nyams len bsrung la g.yel med pa'i/ /mchog gsum bstan pa spel la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dam pa brgyud pa'i byin rlabs 'dus pa yis/ /sangs rgyas ngo bo bla mas mnal lam du/ /don kun 'grub pa'i bkra shis sbyin gyur pas/ /phyogs las rnam par rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyi nang rten 'brel ngo mtshar zab mo yis/ /sa skyong dbang pos 'byor pas legs mchod cing / /mkhas btsun 'dus pa'i tshogs kyis gus btud nas/ /mdzad pa lhun gyis grub la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i rnam thar rgya mtsho las/ /legs tshogs cung zad brjod pa'i bsod nams kyis/ /mkhyen rab dbang phyug rje btsun sa skya pa'i/ /bstan pa dri med phyogs bcur rgyas par shog /tshul 'di dad ldan slob mas rgyang ring nas/ /bskul ba'i ngor ni bsod nams seng ge yis/ /lcags stag sa ga'i rgyal gyi nyi ma la/ /mdo mkhar chos rdzong dgon par sbyar ba dge /shu bhaṃ// // ༄/ /rab 'byams pa shes rab dpal bzang po la bstod pa/ na mo gu ra we/ rgyal chen shes bya'i nam mkha' yangs pa la/ /zab don rab gsal mkhyen pa'i dkyil 'khor rgyas/ /dpal 'byor bzang po'i 'od zer stong 'phro ba/ /thub bstan nyin mor byed pa de la 'dud/ /byin rlabs rgya mtsho bla ma'i tshogs rnams la/ /dad pa rgya mtsho'i yid kyis legs bsten pas/ /gsung rab rgya mtsho'i tshogs la dbang 'byor pa/ /'dzam gling mkhas pa'i dbang po de la 'dud/ /rnam mang rgyud sde'i chu gtsang las 'khrungs pa'i/

/smin byed 'dab stong rim gnyis ze'u 'brus spras/ /dngos grub rnam gnyis sbrang rtsi 'byung ba'i gnas/ /gsang chen theg pa'i chu skyes de la 'dud/ /lhag pa'i lha yis byin brlabs sgo 'byed cing / /dpa' bo mkha' 'gros dgos 'dod char ltar 'bebs/ /bstan srung rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis bka' bzhin sgrub/ /mtshungs bral grub pa'i dbang po de la 'dud/ /padma 'byung gnas thugs kyi phrin las las/ /mi'u thung mgon po'i gzugs su rnam sprul te/ /snyigs dus gdug can drag po 'dul mdzad pa/ /sprul sku 'gro ba'i don mdzad de la 'dud/ /de ltar bstod cing gsol ba btab pa'i mthus/ /gang zhig khyod 'dra'i skyes chen dam pa la/ /mchod dang brnyas pa byas pa'i skye bo kun/ /mtshungs pa nyid du rnam grol bde thob shog /lhag par gsol ba 'debs pa'i slob ma kun/ /tshe 'di nyid la 'gal rkyen kun spangs nas/ /bsam pa'i don rnams yid bzhin 'grub 'gyur te/ /'gro ba'i don du sangs rgyas myur 'grub shog /mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i skyes bu chen po rab 'byams chos rje shes rab dpal bzang po la bstod pa phrin las char 'bebs zhes bya 'di ni/ dbon po 'jam dbyangs dpal gyis bskul nas rje de nyid kyi slob ma bya bral ba bsod nams seng ges mdo mkhar chos rdzong du sbyar ba'o// //shu bhaṃ// // ༄/ /rab byams pa sangs rgyas 'phel la bstod pa kā li spel ba/ oṃ swa sti/ ka la pa sogs rig gnas mthar son nas/ /kha ba can 'dir sangs rgyas gsung rab mchog /ga na bzhugs kyang bsam 'phel nor bu ltar/ /nga bdag spangs nas lhun grub ston la 'dud/ /ca co mi mnga' legs bshad ston pa'i gsung / /cha shas nyes ltung dri mas dben pa'i sku/ /ja sogs sred pas mi rdzi dag pa'i thugs/ /nya ba'i zla ltar dri med de la 'dud/ /ta thā ga ta'i sras kyi thu bo ste/ /tha mal spyod pa ring du rab spangs nas/

/da lta blo gsal bung ba 'dus pa la/ /na rga sel mdzad bdud rtsi ston la 'dud/ /pa sangs ltar gsal blo gros ldan rnams la/ /pha rol phyin sogs zab mo mdo sde dang / /ba mchog lta bur 'dod 'jo'i 'dul ba dang / /ma mo mngon pa'i mig don ston la 'dud/ /tsa ra ka sogs mu stegs gzhung lugs rnams/ /tsha zer rgyal pos mun pa ltar 'joms shing / /dza ya sras bcas stong nyid seng ge'i sgras/ /wa ltar log smra skrag mdzad de la 'dud/ /zhwa bzang lta bur mkhas pa'i thod du mdzes/ /za ma tog ltar yon tan rin chen gnas/ /'a 'ur snyan ltar dam chos sgra dbyangs ldan/ /ya mtshan kun gyi 'byung gnas de la 'dud/ /rwa rtse lta bur rno ba'i rigs pa yis/ /la la dag tu log rtog glang po'i lus/ /sha rus bcas pa ma lus bshig nas kyang / /sa steng 'gran zla bral ba de la 'dud/ /ha ha bzhad pa'i bde nyams ldan pa'i thugs/ /ā li kā li'i sngags kyi rang bzhin gsung / /zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi sku brnyes nas/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba rjes su 'dzin la 'dud/ /kun mkhyen sangs rgyas 'phel la bstod pa bod kyis kā li sum cu dang spel ba 'di ni bya bral ba bsod nams seng ges sbyar ba'o// //shu bhaṃ// // ༄/ /kun mkhyen sangs rgyas 'phel ba la bstod pa/ na mo dharmā swa mi bud dha war dha ye/ dpal ldan lha dbang klu rgyal dpag bsam shing / /rta bdun ri dwags rgyal po yid bzhin nor/ /glang po bsil zer can 'dra'i bla ma la/ /rjes bsngags sdeb sbyor phreng bas bstod par bgyi/ /dge tshogs lhun po'i spo la brtan bzhugs/ /blo gros spyan stong ldan pa'i gzi ldan/ /blo gsal nye dbang tshogs kyis nyer bsten/ /kun mkhyen sangs rgyas 'phel la phyag 'tshal/ /mtha' gnyis gnas bsal dbu ma'i rgya mtshor/ /yang dag rigs pa'i gdengs kas brjid cing / /stong nyid smra ba'i phuṭa sgra cher sgrogs/ /kun mkhyen sangs rgyas 'phel la phyag 'tshal/

/rnam mang thos pa'i rtsa ba brtan cing / /bsam byung rigs pa'i yal gas nyer mdzes/ /zab don bsgom pa'i 'bras bu stong ldan/ /kun mkhyen sangs rgyas 'phel la phyag 'tshal/ /ma lus gsung rab mkhyen pa'i nam mkha'/ /skyong bral sdom gsum dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs/ /byams dang snying rje'i 'od zer stong 'phro/ /kun mkhyen sangs rgyas 'phel la phyag 'tshal/ /legs bshad 'chad pa'i lus stobs cher rgyas/ /rigs lam rtsod pa'i mche sder rno zhing / /spel legs rtsom pa'i ral pa'i khur ldan/ /kun mkhyen sangs rgyas 'phel la phyag 'tshal/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa dbang gi rgyal po/ /bshad sgrub rgyal mtshan rtse mor mchod nas/ /gdul bya'i dgos 'dod 'phel ba'i mthu ldan/ /kun mkhyen sangs rgyas 'phel la phyag 'tshal/ /rnam dkar 'dul ba'i drwa bas nyer mdzes/ /rgya chen mngon pa'i yan lag bdun ldan/ /zab mo mdo sde'i khur gyis brjid pa'i/ /kun mkhyen sangs rgyas 'phel la phyag 'tshal/ /dngos stobs rigs pa'i dkyil 'khor las 'byung / /sgrub dang sun 'byin 'od dkar drwa bas/ /thub bstan kun da'i phreng ba rgyas mdzad/ /kun mkhyen sangs rgyas 'phel la phyag 'tshal/ /bsngags 'os gang de'i yon tan cha tsam/ /rjes bsngags sdeb sbyor phreng bas spel ba'i/ /bsngags 'os dge des kun mkhyen bla ma/ /'gro ba'i gtsug na bsngags par shog cig /thub bstan pad mo'i tshal rab rgyas shing / /'gro la lam bzang snang ba'i ched du/ /'dren mchog nyin byed sku tshe brtan zhing / /phrin las phyogs bcur rgyas par shog cig /tshul 'di bsod nams seng ge'i mgur nas/ /phyung ste skyed tshal mdzes pa'i blo gsal/ /'dus pa'i tshogs la skyes su 'bul gyi/ /bstod dbyangs snyan pa'i rdza rnga sgrogs shig /shu bhaṃ// // ༄/ /mkhas pa gung ru la bstod pa/ shes bya'i mkha' la mkhyen pa'i 'od stong gis/ /rab tu gsal ba'i snang ba rgya che zhing / /phrin las bzang po gdul bya pad mo'i gnyen/

/mtshungs med bstan pa'i nyi ma de la 'dud/ /rgya chen thos pa'i gangs ri mthon po'i ngos/ /phul byung bsam pa'i zla 'od kyis 'khyud pas/ /zab don bsgom pa'i snang ba rab rgyas te/ /dam chos bsil zer 'phro ba de la 'dud/ /rnam mang lung gi gdengs kas spyi bo mdzes/ /rnam dag sdeb sbyor phreng bas mgul pa brgyan/ /rnam dpyod rigs pa'i phuṭa sgra cher sgrogs pa'i/ /mkhas mchog klu yi dbang po de la 'dud/ /mtha' yas rgyud sde'i dgongs pa bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /zab yangs blo gros bum par legs bsdus nas/ /blo gsal blo yi spyi bor dbang bskur ba/ /man ngag bcud gtams bum bzang de la 'dud/ /dam pa'i yon tan cha tsam brjod pa las/ /dam chos dge ba gang zhig thob pa des/ /dam tshig sdom pa rnam dag dang ldan zhing / /dam pas bsngags pa'i lam la gnas par shog /mkhas pa'i mkhas pa shes rab bzang po la/ /bstod pa'i rab byed don ldan sbrang rtsi 'di/ /bsod nams seng ge'i blo yi pad mo las/ /phyung ste don gnyer bung ba'i tshogs la sbyin/ /tshe rabs thams cad du yang dpal ldan bla mas rjes su 'dzin par gyur cig /dge'o// // ༄/ /dkon mchog rgyal po la bstod pa/ rigs rus cho 'brang ldan zhing rig 'dzin gyi/ /rigs 'khrungs dkon mchog gsum dang dbyer med pa'i/ /chos kyi rgyal po bla ma mchog khyod la/ /rtag tu gus pas bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /dge'o// // ༄/ bdag chen blo gros pa la bstod pa/ na mo gu ra we/ zab yangs blo gros rgya mtsho'i dbus gnas shing / /rim gnyis rgyal mtshan gdengs kas mngon par brjid/ /dpal 'byor bzang po'i nor bu gtsug na mdzes/ /yongs 'dzin klu yi dbang po la phyag 'tshal/ /phul byung rigs kyi gangs ri mtho ba'i ngos/ /lhag bsam dkar po'i zla zer dang ldan zhing / /dam pa'i spyod tshul chu gtsang 'byung ba'i gzhi/ /'dren pa ri dbang che la mgos phyag 'tshal/ /rnam mang thos pa'i rtsa ba rab brtan zhing /

/bsam byung rigs pa'i yal ga phun tshogs ldan/ /zab don bsgoms pa'i 'bras bzang stsol ba can/ /bla chen dpag bsam ljon pa la phyag 'tshal/ /dpag yas thugs rje'i spyan zur dri med kyis/ /srid gsum 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal ma bzod nas/ /bla med byang chub bsgrub la brtson mdzad pa/ /mtshan nas brjod par dka' ba khyod phyag 'tshal/ /blo gros spyi bor bla ma'i cod paṇa 'dzin/ /phrin las rgyal mtshan mkha' 'gros phyogs bcur spel/ /snyan grags dpal 'byor srung mas sgrub mdzad pa/ /dge mtshan bzang po'i gter la mgos phyag 'tshal/ /'gro mgon bla ma'i yon tan rjes bsngags pa'i/ /bsod nams gang des khams gsum 'gro ba kun/ /sdug bsngal rgya mtsho che las rab bsgral nas/ /bde chen thar pa'i gnas la 'jog par shog /khyad par mkhyen rab dbang phyug sa skya pa'i/ /bstan pa dri med gdul bya'i padmo la/ /rgyun du khyab cing lam mchog gsal ba dang / /phan bde'i lo thog rgyas pa'i rgyur gyur cig /'gro ba'i bla ma blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la bstod pa yon tan gsal ba'i nyi 'od ces bya ba 'di ni dad ldan gyi slob ma rnams kyis bskul ba'i ngor/ shākya'i dge slong bsod nams seng ges dpal ldan sa skya yon tan rin po che'i 'byung gnas su sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dbus pa grags bzang ngo // // ༄/ /slob dpon kun dga' 'bum gyi bstod pa/ thugs rjes nam yang 'gro ba mi gtong zhing / /gsung rab mkha' la mkhyen pa'i nyi 'od kyis/ /zab don dpal 'byor bzang po'i snang ba can/ /yongs 'dzin dam pa'i zhabs la gus phyag 'tshal/ /gsung rab kun gyi cha shas yongs su rdzogs/ /dam chos dga' ston gdul bya'i mkha' la 'char/ /dge legs 'bum phrag du ma'i 'od dkar can/ /smra ba'i zla ba bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud// // ༄/ /oṃ swa sti/ rgya chen bsom̐d nam̐ms lus stobs rab rgyas te/ /bde gshegs gsung rab sem̐ng gem̐'i nga ro yis/

/log smra'i ri dwags mtha' dag skrag byed pa'i/ /thub bstan gangs ri skyong ba de la 'dud/ /dge'o// // ༄/ gdams pa'i rin chen lhun brtsegs mchog /bsom̐d nam̐ms rgya mtsho'i dbus gnas shing / /legs bshad sem̐ng gem̐'i bsti gnas che/ /yon tan ri dbang la phyag 'tshal/ /dge'o// // ༄/ oṃ swa sti/ dkon mchog gsum dngos bla ma nyer bsten nas/ /rmad byung yon tan kun gyi gter mnga' zhing / /gsang chen bstan pa 'phel ba'i phrin las can/ /'dren mchog chos kyi rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dge'o// // ༄/ /paṇḍi ta grags pa rdo rje'i bstod pa/ ma hā paṇḍi ta grags pa rdo rje la bstod pa dad pa'i pad mo rgyas byed ces bya ba/ dpal ldan 'jam pa'i rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /blo gros dkyil 'khor grags pa'i gzi 'bar ba/ /mi 'gyur rdo rje'i mkha' la rnam rol zhing / /bde gshegs bstan pa'i pad tshal rgyas mdzad pa/ /mkhas mchog nyin byed dbang po la phyag 'tshal/ /legs gsung 'dul ba rgya mtsho'i dbus gnas shing / /rnam dag tshul khrims bslab pa'i me 'od kyis/ /'chal tshul smag rum mun pa bsal mdzad pa/ /gnas brtan gdengs can dbang po la phyag 'tshal/ /srid gsum 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sel ba'i phyir/ /theg mchog lam gyi them skas kun 'dzegs te/ /rgyal ba'i phrin las ma lus bsgrub mdzad pa/ /rab 'byams rgyal sras dbang po la phyag 'tshal/ /mtha' yas rgyud sde'i dgongs pa bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /rmad byung brtson pa'i snyim pas legs gsol nas/ /skal ldan 'gro la tshul bzhin 'doms mdzad pa/ /gsang chen gdams pa'i dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal/ /rig gnas pad mo zum pa ma bzod nas/ /yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag paṇḍi ta/ /'jam dbyangs nyi ma slar yang gsal byon pa/ /'dzam gling mkhas pa'i dbang po la phyag 'tshal/ /dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod sprin rgya chen 'bul/ /sdig pa kun bshags dge la rjes yi rang / /zab yangs chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang /

/rtag tu mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs su gsol/ /gang sku rin chen gser ltar bzang ba dang / /de'i gsung grags pas sa dang mkha' khyab cing / /khyod thugs rdo rje lta bur brtan pa yis/ /bde gshegs bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas byed shog /paṇa chen grags pa rdo rje yi/ /yon tan cha tsam brjod pas kyang / /dad pa'i pad mo rgyas byed 'di/ /bsod nams seng ges sbyar ba dge/ // ༄/ gling smad paṇḍi ta la bstod pa/ shes bya'i de nyid gzigs pa'i blo gros kyis/ /rab 'byams gzhung gi dgongs pa padmo'i tshal/ /legs par 'byed pa'i dpal yon phun tshogs ldan/ /kun mkhyen chos kyi rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sngon tshe 'phags yul dam chos rgya mtsho'i gling / /mdzes par brgyan pa'i yongs rdzogs paṇḍi tar/ /legs 'khrungs thugs rje'i dbang gis gangs can 'dir/ /bstan pa'i dpal du shar la gus phyag 'tshal/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug dge ba'i ngang tshul can/ /rigs pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i thugs kyi sras/ /bshad dang sgrub pa'i rigs kyi gdung 'tshob pa/ /dam pa'i rnam thar skyong la gus phyag 'tshal/ /lung rigs bye ba'i 'brug sgra 'byung ba'i gzhi/ /thub bstan sprin sngon rol pa'i khang bzang der/ /sa bcu'i dbang phyug blo ldan bzang po yi/ /rgyal tshab dam pa gyur la gus phyag 'tshal/ /sde snod rgya mtsho'i dbus na gnas bcas shing / /rnam mang rgyud sde gser ri'i dbus na brjid/ /rnam dag bsgrubs pa'i rin chen las grub pa/ /yon tan kun gyis lhun po la phyag 'tshal/ /dge legs yon tan kun gyis brgyan pa'i mthus/ /skal ldan 'gro ba kun gyi skyabs gyur cing / /lung rigs man ngag du ma'i dpal ster ba/ /phrin las dbang phyug de la gus phyag 'tshal/ /shes rab zab mo'i dpal ldan skyes chen gyi/ /legs tshogs cung zad brjod pa'i bsod nams des/ /mkha' mnyam 'gro la phan bdes kun khyab cing / /yongs 'dzin dam pa'i byin rlabs 'jug par shog

/tshul 'di dad ldan nam mkha' bzang po yis/ /bskul nas bsod nams seng ge'i rnam dpyod las/ /'bad med lhun gyis grub par phyung nas ni/ /thub bstan rnam par rgyal ba'i dgon par bris/ /dge'o// // ༄/ /karma pa'i bstod pa/ na mo lo ki shwa rā ya/ khams gsum 'gro la thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /dus gsum shes bya mkhyen pa'i ye shes can/ /gnas gsum mkha' 'gro 'dus pa kun gyi gtso/ /skyes mchog karma pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dus gsum mkhyen pa mtshungs bral pag shi'i mtshan/ /rang byung rol pa'i rdo rje de bzhin gshegs/ /mthong ba don ldan rnams su sku brgyud nas/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba 'dren mdzad la phyag 'tshal/ /mnyam gzhag rang byung bde chen ngang la bzhugs/ /rjes thob chos kun dbye ba so sor gzigs/ /phrin las dam pa'i chos kyi 'od zer 'gyed/ /skal ldan kun gyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal/ /skyes ma thag nas byis pa'i spyod pa las/ /shin tu 'das shing nga ni karma pa/ /srid pa gsum na 'gran zla bral lo zhes/ /mi 'jigs dam bca' mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshad med bzhi ldan lhag bsam rgya mtsho'i dbus/ /bsdu dngos bzhi yi bang rim phreng ba can/ /rgyud sde bzhi yi lcog gis nyer mdzes pa/ /gsang ba kun gyi lhun po la phyag 'tshal/ /dug lnga'i chu bo thabs mkhas bdud rtsi yis/ /ye shes lnga yi lam du bsgyur mdzad cing / /rigs lnga'i khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen gyi/ /go 'phang mngon du mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rigs drug 'gro la sprul pa 'gyed pa'i sku/ /yig drug sgra dbyangs phyogs bcur sgrogs pa'i gsung / /mngon shes drug po chags thogs med pa'i thugs/ /yon tan phrin las lhun grub la phyag 'tshal/ /steng nas lha yis mchod pa'i char chen phab/ /bar du skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyur/ /'og nas gdengs can gtsug gi nor bus gtugs/ /sa gsum 'gro ba'i mgon po la phyag 'tshal/ /gang sku mthong ba tsam gyis rab tu dang /

/gsung mchog thos pas ngan 'gro'i 'jigs las skyob/ /mkhyen brtse dran pas srid zhi'i dpal 'byor ster/ /rnam thar bsam mi khyab la phyag 'tshal lo/ /snyigs dus 'gro ba'i skyabs mgon karma pa/ /tshul bzhin bsngags pa'i rnam dkar dge tshogs kyis/ /mar gyur 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal rab zhi nas/ /bde chen thar pa'i 'byor ba thob par shog /bstod pa'i tshul 'di bstod yul de nyid la/ /sangs rgyas nyid 'dzin sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gyis/ /legs par bskul nas legs pa'i blo ldan pa/ /bsod nams thob phyir bsod nams seng ges bris/ /dge'o// // ༄/ rje rin po che sku skye ba'i drung gi bstod pa/ oṃ swasti/ chos rje bsod nams chos kyi kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la bstod pa/ yon tan gsal ba'i mtshan gyi zla zer zhes bya ba/ mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phun tshogs bsod nams dpal las 'khrungs pa'i sku/ /legs byas bsod nams brgya yis bskrun pa'i gsung / /rgya chen bsod nams ye shes ldan pa'i thugs/ /gang la mnga' ba'i skyes chen de la 'dud/ /theg chen chos kyi snying po bsdus pa'i bcud/ /zab yangs chos kyi de nyid rtogs pa'i thabs/ /gsung ngag chos kyis rang rgyud rnam grol nas/ /gzhan rgyud smin par mdzad pa de la 'dud/ /mkhas pa kun dga'i mkhyen pa zab mo dang / /'gro ba kun dga'i thugs rje rmad byung gis/ /rgyal ba kun dga' phrin las sgrub mdzad pa/ /mkhyen brtse nus pa mthar phyin de la 'dud/ /thos mang bkra shis rtsa ba rab brtan zhing / /bsam byung bkra shis me tog rnam par bkra/ /bsgoms pa'i bkra shis nyams rtogs 'bras bus brgyan/ /dpag yas yon tan ljon pa de la 'dud/ /dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gsung gi man ngag las/ /chos kyi rgyal mtshan dri med legs bzung nas/ /bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin par dbang bskur te/ /lung bstan dbugs dbyung brnyes pa de la 'dud/

/tshogs gnyis dpal 'byor gting mtha' mi mngon zhing / /srid zhi'i dpal 'byor rin chen du mas gtams/ /don gnyis dpal 'byor rba rlabs rab g.yo ba/ /dge legs kun gyi rgya mtsho de la 'dud/ /grags pa bzang po la sogs mtshungs bral ba'i/ /yongs 'dzin bzang po'i bka' lung mthar phyin nas/ /phrin las bzang pos thub bstan rgyas mdzad pa/ /ston pa'i bstan 'dzin de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin rgya cher 'bul/ /kun rtog ngan pa'i nyes rnams so sor bshags/ /kun gyi dge ba kun la rjes yi rang / /kun mkhyen chos 'khor bskor zhing rtag bzhugs gsol/ /sgo gsum dwang bas bstod pa'i bsod nams dang / /dus gsum bsags pa'i dge gzhan ci mchis pa/ /'khor gsum rnam par mi rtog shes rab kyis/ /sku gsum mngon 'gyur sangs rgyas thob phyir bsngo/ /rgyal ba 'gro la dam chos ston pa dang / /dam chos spyod pas dge 'dun rgyas pa dang / /dge 'dun bder gshegs bstan pa skyong ba yis/ /bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /tshul 'di thos bsam ri mo rab bkra stag dang ni/ /sgom pa'i log zhol 'phyang ba'i gnas brtan rgya bo yis/ /yang yang bskul nas gsung rab brag la gnas bcas shing / /lung rigs gshog yangs rgyas pa go bos sbyar/ /dge'o// // ༄/ chu 'dus mkhas btsun pa la bstod pa/ na mo gu ṇa sā ga ra/ lhag bsam gser gyi sa 'dzin cher yangs par/ /rmad byung yon tan chu bo kun 'du zhing / /phrin las rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs g.yo ba can/ /mkhas btsun chos kyi rje la gsol ba 'debs/ /tshul khrims phung pos mngon par brjid pa'i sku/ /man ngag bdud rtsi dus su 'doms pa'i gsung / /ting 'dzin zab cing yangs pa'i thugs mnga' ba/ /mkhas btsun chos kyi rje la gsol ba 'debs/ /thos pa'i khang bzang dbang lung nor gyis phyug /bsam byung rig pa'i ri mo rnam bkra zhing / /nyams rtogs yon tan nor bu legs spras pa/

/mkhas btsun chos kyi rje la gsol ba 'debs/ /kun mkhyen bla ma'i gsung gi 'od zer gyis/ /blo gros padmo rnam par phye ba las/ /phrin las sbrang rtsi'i dga' ston 'gyed mdzad pa/ /mkhas btsun chos kyi rje la gsol ba 'debs/ /yon tan rgya mtsho bla ma'i rnam thar las/ /cha tsam dad pa rgya mtshos legs brjod pa'i/ /bsod nams rgya mtsho gang zhig thob pa des/ /sangs rgyas ye shes rgya mtshor 'jug par shog /bla ma'i yon tan rjes bsngags pa/ /thugs sras dam pas bskul ba'i ngor/ /bsod nams rigs pa'i seng ge yis/ /bstod tshig sgra dbyangs 'di bsgrags so/ /dge'o// // ༄/ /'chum sde chen gyi mkhan po nam mkha' dpal skyong gi bstod pa/ na mo gu ra we/ lhag bsam nam mkhar thugs rje'i sprin bsdus nas/ /dam chos bdud rtsi'i dpal gyi char rgyun gyis/ /rnam grol dge ba'i lo thog skyong mdzad pa/ /mkhan chen rin po che la gus phyag 'tshal/ /rlabs chen smon lam rnam par dag pa'i mthus/ /rgyal ba'i ring lugs 'dzin pa'i rigs 'khrungs te/ /gzhon nu nyid nas thub bstan rgyal srid kyi/ /khur chen 'dzin par mdzad la gus phyag 'tshal/ /dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i rigs bdag rdo rje 'chang / /sras kyi thu bor bcas pa'i legs bshad kyi/ /bdud rtsi'i rgyun bzang ngoms par legs gsol nas/ /man ngag gter du gyur la gus phyag 'tshal/ /rnam dag bslab gsum rin chen gyis gtams pa'i/ /legs gsung 'dul ba'i rlabs phreng g.yo ba can/ /byang chub mchog gi gdengs can bsti ba'i gnas/ /gnas brtan chen po'i zhabs la gus phyag 'tshal/ /byams dang snying rje'i rtsa ba rab brtan pa'i/ /byang chub sems kyi ljon pa'i lo 'dab kyis/ /srid dang zhi ba'i gdung ba kun skyob pa/ /sems dpa' chen po'i zhabs la mgos phyag 'tshal/ /rmad byung gdams pas rang rgyud rnam grol nas/ /gsang chen bstan pa nyi ma'i 'od zer gyis/ /skal ldan 'gro la lam mchog snang mdzad pa/

/rdo rje 'dzin pa'i zhabs la gus phyag 'tshal/ /gcig tu 'gro la brtse ba'i thugs rje yis/ /bstan la phan bde 'byung bar legs gzigs nas/ /rgyal ba'i bstan la mchog tu gces 'dzin pa/ /'gro ba kun gyi 'dren pa la phyag 'tshal/ /dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod sprin rgya chen dbul/ /sdig pa kun bshags dge la rjes yi rang / /chos 'khor bskor zhing mya ngan mi 'da' bar/ /'gro ba'i don du rtag par bzhugs su gsol/ /de ltar bstod cing gsol ba btab pa las/ /byung ba'i dge tshogs nyi ltar gsal ba yis/ /mkha' mnyam 'gro ba'i snying mun kun bsal nas/ /bla med byang chub mchog la 'god par shog /nye bar bsten pa'i gnas mchog sde chen 'di/ /srid zhi'i dpal 'byor kun gyis legs gang nas/ /thub bstan dri med rgyun du skyong ba dang / /dam chos sgra chen sgrogs pa'i gzhir gyur cig /ces pa 'di yang gnas mchog de'i/ /slob tshogs kun gyis rab bskul nas/ /blo ldan bsod nams seng ge yis/ /gzhan la phan pa'i ched du sbyar/ /dge'o// // ༄/ /slob dpon sbyin bzang pa'i bstod pa/ na mo gu ra we/ dge legs rin chen kun gyi gter gyur pa/ /legs gsung 'dul ba rgya mtsho'i dbus gnas shing / /bslab gsum gdengs kas brjid pa'i gzi 'od can/ /'dul 'dzin chen po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /rlabs chen byang chub sems kyi chu mtsho las/ /sbyin sogs spyod pa'i 'dab stong rab rgyas te/ /phrin las bzang po'i ze'u 'brus legs spras pa'i/ /rgyal sras chen po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /rnam mang rgyud sde'i rin chen las grub cing / /rmad byung dbang bzhi'i bang rim phreng ba can/ /rim gnyis nyi zla gsal ba'i mdangs ldan pa/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /dpal ldan bla mar tshul bzhin bsngags pa yi/ /dge tshogs gang des gnas 'di longs spyod dang / /chos kyis rgyas shing mtha' yas 'gro ba kun/

/kun mkhyen rgyal po'i go 'phang myur thob shog /bstan pa'i rtsa lag sbyin pa bzang po zhes/ /rab tu grags pa de yi bstod tshig 'di/ /dad ldan blo gros 'bum gyis legs bskul nas/ /mang thos dge slong bsod nams seng ges sbyar/ /dge'o// // ༄/ /rje nyid kyis bzhengs pa'i gsung ngag brgyud pa'i bris sku'i ngos nas bshus te bris pa'i brgyud 'debs/ oṃ swasti/ zung 'jug mchog gi sa brnyes rdo rje 'chang / /gsang ba kun bdag ye shes mkha' 'gro'i gtso/ /phung sogs rnam dag gdan gsum tshang ba yi/ /skur bskyed dkyil 'khor lha la gus phyag 'tshal/ /mthu stobs bsam yas dpal ldan birwa pa/ /rdo rje'i tshig gis rnam grol nag po pa/ /bde stong mchog gi dbang phyug ḍā ma ru/ /gnyis spangs spyod pa mdzad la gus phyag 'tshal/ /gangs can 'dul mdzad ga ya dha ra dpal/ /dam chos gter mdzod bla chen 'brog mi'i zhabs/ /nus mthu mthar phyin se ston kun rig dang / /yon tan mnga' brnyes chos 'bar la phyag 'tshal/ /'gro kun thugs rjes dga' mdzad spyan ras gzigs/ /rgyal ba'i ye shes snying po 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /gsang gsum kun 'dus gsang bdag rdo rje 'dzin/ /rje btsun sa skya pa la gus phyag 'tshal/ /mi thub zla ba'i sprul pa bsod nams rtse/ /rdo rje 'dzin sa bdun brnyes grags pa'i mtshan/ /'jam dbyangs mi yis don mdzad chos kyi rje/ /bla chen 'phags pa'i zhabs la gus phyag 'tshal/ /sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan legs 'dzin tshogs sgom pa/ /nyams dang rtogs pa mthar phyin nyan chen pa/ /snyan brgyud gdams pa'i mdzod 'dzin dkon mchog dpal/ /rim gnyis mthar phyin brag phug pa la 'dud/ /'gro ba'i bla ma bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal/ /mdo rgyud kun mkhyen mtshungs med ri khrod pa/ /snyan brgyud gdams pa'i bdag po dpal ldan pa/ /sbas pa'i rnal 'byor buddha shrī la 'dud/ /gsung rab kun 'dzin mkhyen pa'i gter mnga' ba/

/kun dga' bzang po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'gro ba kun 'dzin thugs rje'i gter mnga' ba/ /dkon mchog rgyal mtshan zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /grong khyer gsum 'jig thub bstan grong khyer skyong / /'jigs rung zhal gdangs 'jigs rung gad rgyang sgrogs/ /dpung chen nus mthus bdud kyi dpung chen 'joms/ /bstan srung khyod kyis bstan pa 'di skyongs shig/ // ༄/ /kye rdor 'grel pa lugs kyi brgyud pa'i kha skong / blo gros phun tshogs thub bstan rgyal mtshan 'dzin/ /dpal ldan phrin las bzang po skye rgu'i mgon/ /chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rtag tu bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /'phags pas rjes bzung rgyud don ma lus rig /rmad byung bshad pa'i srol 'dzin dga' ldan pa/ /bkra shis dpal gyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rtag tu bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /rab dkar bsod nams brgya yi gangs ri las/ /rmad byung mkhyen brtse'i dpal gyi chu rgyun can/ /rgyal ba brag phug pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rtag tu bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /rnam dag blo gros nam mkha' yangs pa la/ /rab tu brtan pa'i ting 'dzin dkyil 'khor rgyas/ /mtshungs med ri khrod pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rtag tu bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /tshogs gnyis dpal ldan sgrib gnyis g.yul las rgyal/ /sdom gsum tshul khrims nyes gsum dri mas dben/ /dpal ldan tshul khrims zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rtag tu bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /ye shes khang bzang thugs rje'i rgyal mtshan gyis/ /legs par spras pa'i dpal 'byor bzang po can/ /rje btsun rtog med zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rtag tu bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /khyod thugs shes bya kun la legs sbyangs pas/ /rgyal ba'i bstan la rgyal ba gnyis par gyur/ /'dren mchog bzang po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rtag tu bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/

/rnam dag mkhyen pas chos kun sgyu mar gzigs/ /dmigs med thugs rjes gzhan la phan dgongs pa/ /dkon mchog rgyal mtshan zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rtag tu bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /zhes pa 'di ni chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pas mdzad pa'i kye rdor 'grel pa lugs kyi brgyud pa'i kha skong du dge slong bsod nams seng ges sbyar ba'o// //dge'o// // ༄/ /bde mchog brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs kha skong / bdud dang mu stegs 'chi bdag sogs/ /rgol ba kun gyi nga rgyal 'joms/ /lha dang dge sbyong bram ze sogs/ /bstan la dga' ba kun dga' mdzad/ /mtshungs pa med pa'i rgyal mtshan can/ /rmad du byung ba'i dpal mnga' ba/ /bzang po khyod kyi zhabs rdul la/ /rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs/ /zab cing rgya che'i blo gros can/ /thugs rje'i rgyal mtshan dri ma med/ /phrin las dpal 'byor bzang po la/ /rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs/ /rnyed par dkon pa'i bde gshegs gsung / /gdams pa mchog tu shar ba yi/ /skye rgu'i dpal du gyur pa la/ /rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs/ /snyan brgyud gdams pa'i mdzod 'dzin cing / /rim gnyis rnal 'byor mthar phyin pa/ /rje btsun brag phug pa yi zhabs/ /rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs/ /blo gros rgya mtsho'i dbus na gnas/ /bslab gsum bang rim rab tu brtan/ /bsdu bzhi'i cog gis mdzes pa la/ /rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs/ /man ngag rgya mtsho'i dpal dang ldan/ /brtse bas 'gro la legs 'doms shing / /sdom gsum tshul khrims ldan pa la/ /rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs/ /ye shes chen po'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin/ /dpal 'byor bzang pos 'gro kun skyong / /rje btsun rtog med zhabs pad la/ /rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs/ /shes bya kun sbyangs blo gros can/ /'gro kun dga' mdzad thugs rje can/ /dri med brtul zhugs bzang po la/ /rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs/

/gang gi mtshan tsam dran pas kyang / /srid zhi'i rgud pa kun sel ba/ /'dren mchog rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes pa 'di'i tshigs bcad dang po gnyis ni/ /gling ka bde ba can gyi phyag dpe rnying pa zhig gi dkyus na 'dug pa bris pa yin la lhag ma rnams ni/ dpal ldan sa skya paṇḍi tas mdzad pa'i 'khor lo bde mchog gi bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs kyi kha skong du dge slong bsod nams seng ges bris pa'o/ /dge'o// // ༄/ /gsang 'dus rim lnga'i brgyud 'debs kha skong / e waṃ zab cing rgya che'i dam chos kyi/ /dpal ldan gnas mchog dbus bzhugs rdo rje 'chang / /bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gus pas gsol 'debs bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// // ༄/ /phar phyin brgyud 'debs/ na mo ārya mai tri nā thā ya/ 'gro ba'i bla ma ston pa rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /'gro kun byams pas rjes bzung mi pham mgon/ /'gro la brtse bas rjes chags thogs med zhabs/ /'gro ba'i 'dren pa gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyal ba gnyis pa kun mkhyen dbyig gi gnyen/ /rgyal ba'i gdung 'dzin 'phags pa rnam grol sde/ /rgyal sras thu bo btsun pa rnam grol sde/ /rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /dge 'dun 'dus pa'i rgyan gyur mchog gi sde/ /dge legs byams pa'i thugs mnga' dul ba'i sde/ /dge ba'i gter mdzod mkhan po rnam snang mdzad/ /dge ba'i 'byung gnas gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /yum don dgongs pa gsal mdzad seng ge bzang / /yum don rtogs pas rnam grol ye shes zhabs/ /yum don thugs chud yon tan gshes gnyen te/ /yum don mthar phyin gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan rin chen bzang po dang / /mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa zla ba bzang / /mkhas mang 'dus pa'i gtso bo bstan skyong zhabs/ /mkhas grub dam pa gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /rab 'byams shes bya kun mkhyen lo tstsha ba/

/rab mchog sher phyin rgyas mdzad shes rab 'bar/ /rab gsal thugs mnga' byang chub ye shes zhabs/ /rab dkar blo ldan gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /mtha' gnyis rnam grol gzhon nu tshul khrims dang / /mtha' bral stong nyid don rtogs shes rab 'bum/ /mtha' yas byang chub sems ldan byang chub 'bum/ /mtha' dag yongs 'dzin gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /kun rtog rnam spangs 'jam pa'i rdo rje dang / /kun tu gsal ba'i mkhyen ldan dar tshul zhabs/ /kun la phan dgongs brtson 'grus rdo rje ste/ /kun gyi re skong gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /srid zhi'i dgra las rnam rgyal rin po che/ /srid pa'i nyes spong grub pa seng ge dang / /srid gsum mkhas pa tshad ma'i skyes bu'i zhabs/ /srid pa'i 'dren pa gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /mkhyen ldan sdom brtson bu ston rin chen grub/ /mkhyen pa'i spyan gsal rin chen rnam rgyal zhabs/ /mkhyen bzang bstan pa'i mnga' bdag sangs rgyas dpal/ /mkhyen rab dbang phyug gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /thub dbang gnyis pa rong ston chos kyi rje/ /thub pa'i bstan pa gsal mdzad sangs rgyas 'phel/ /thub mchog dges pa'i bshes gnyen rnam gnyis la/ /thub pa bzhin du dad pas gsol ba 'debs/ /rab 'byams phyogs bcu'i zhing khams mtha' yas na/ /rab mdzes mchod pa'i yo byad ci mchis rnams/ /rab mchog zhing gyur bla ma'i tshogs rnams la/ /rab dkar dad pa'i sems kyis rgyas par 'bul/ /ma dag nyes pa'i tshogs rnams so sor bshags/ /ma lus dge ba kun la rje yi rang / /ma rig bsal phyir chos 'khor bskor ba dang / /ma rnams don du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ /de nyid don gzigs bla ma'i tshogs rnams la/ /de ltar bstod cing gsol ba btab pa'i mthus/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i yum mchog sher phyin la/ /de don rtogs phyir thos bsam byed par shog /rnam dag thos dang bsam pas rgyud sbyangs nas/ /rnam mnga' 'gro la phan bde bsgrub pa'i phyir/

/rnam dkar byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed de/ /rnam grol theg chen lam du 'jug par shog /rnam pa kun tu 'bras bu thob phyir du/ /lam gsum shes pa'i tshul la legs sbyangs te/ /gzhi kun shes pa gnyis su rab phye nas/ /lam dang lam min sgro 'dogs chod par shog /mkhyen gsum bsdus nas bsgoms pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /rtogs pa rab kyi mthar phyin thob nas kyang / /slar yang de dag go rim ji bzhin dang / /cig char bsgoms pa'i nyams len mthar phyin shog /zag med yon tan kun ldan rang bzhin sku/ /yid 'ong mtshan dpe rab mdzes longs spyod rdzogs/ /sna tshogs gdul bya'i re skong sprul pa'i sku/ /mngon du gyur nas phrin las dbang bskur shog /zung 'jug chos sku ma thob de srid du/ /dga' ldan chos kyis mtho ba'i khang bzangs der/ /mi pham chos kyi bla ma'i zhabs drung du/ /theg chen chos kyi dga' ston myong bar shog /tshe 'dir tshe ring nad med tshul khrims dag /thos mang thos pa'i don sems sgom byed cing / /yongs 'dzin yongs kyi legs bshad bdud rtsi yis/ /blo ldan blo yi re ba skong bar shog /brtse chen bla ma rnams kyi thugs rje dang / /rin chen dkon mchog gsum gyi byin rlabs dang / /yum chen pha rol phyin pa'i bden pa yis/ /rgya chen smon lam 'di dag myur 'grub shog /shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa'i bla ma brgyud pa la gsol ba 'debs pa'i rim pa bstod tshig rgyan gyi phreng ba zhes bya ba 'di ni phyogs med rgyal khams kyi bya bral ba bsod nams seng ges chu pho rta'i lo cho 'phrul chen po'i zla ba la 'bras yul rdzong dkar gyi skyed mos tshal du sbyar ba'o// //dge'o// // ༄/ /tshad ma'i brgyud 'debs/ mtha' dag 'gro la phan bzhed thugs rje yis/ /bden bzhi rtogs pa'i thabs la mngon sbyor nas/ /grangs med gsum du brtson pas legs bsgoms pas/ /bde gshegs skyob pa brnyes la gsol ba 'debs/

/bsam yas mkhyen pa'i gter chen 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /nyon mongs dgra las rnam rgyal 'chos skyob zhabs/ /de sras thu bo paṇa chen me wang 'ga'/ /mkhas mchog dbyig gnyen rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /phas rgol 'dam bu'i grong 'joms phyogs glang po/ /rmad byung bshad pa'i srol 'dzin dbang phyug sde/ /sde bdun chos kyi sgra sgrogs grags pa'i mtshan/ /lha dbang blo gros rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /shākya'i ring lugs 'dzin pa blo gros bzang / /phul byung shes rab 'byung gnas blo gros che/ /'chi bdag bdud kyi dpung 'joms yā ma shrī/ /rgyal rnga bdun pa rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /dam pa rang gzhan skyong mdzad dul ba lha/ /bram ze lnga rig bde byed dga' ba dang / /theg chen chos kyi nus ldan wang gu'i zhabs/ /'phags yul sgron me rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /dpal ldan kha che'i mkhan po bsod snyoms pa/ /de sras bde gshegs dpal dang sam ga shrī/ /dā nā shī la 'jam dbyangs bla ma yi/ /sgra tshad 'byung gnas bzhi la gsol ba 'debs/ /dpal ldan sa skya bstan pa'i gangs rir gnas/ /mu stegs rgol ngan wa tshogs mthar mdzad cing / /skal ldan blo gsal ri dwags tshogs skyong ba/ /'jam mgon bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /dngos stobs rigs pa'i seng ge 'u yug pa/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas mdzad mdo sde dpal/ /mkhyen pa'i spyan gsal 'jam dbyangs skya bo'i zhabs/ /blo gros brtan pa rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /'gro ba'i mgon po bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal/ /rigs lam gsal mdzad mkhas pa brtson 'grus dpal/ /dga' ldan chos kyi rgyal tshab sangs rgyas dpal/ /shes bya kun rig rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /srid gsum 'gro ba'i rtsa lag grags pa'i mtshan/ /bde gshegs bstan pa'i rtsa lag sangs rgyas 'phel/ /zab don gnad kyi rtsa lag yongs 'dzin mchog /rigs lam brgyud pa rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /khams gsum 'gro la dmigs pa'i snying rje yi/

/dmigs rnam skye ba du mar goms pa'i mthus/ /'bad rtsol med par rang gi ngang nyid kyis/ /sems nyid thugs rjer 'gyur bar byin gyis rlobs/ /yid ches lung dang dngos stobs rigs pa yis/ /sdug bsngal rgyu dang gnyen po legs brtags nas/ /bdag med rtogs pa gnyen por shes gyur te/ /brtson pa gnyis kyis bsgom par byin gyis rlobs/ /lam mchog goms pa rab mthar phyin pa'i mthus/ /rtogs pa khyad par gsum dang ldan pa yi/ /spangs pa khyad par gsum ldan mngon gyur te/ /bde gshegs go 'phang thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /nyid kyi ji ltar gzigs pa'i theg gsum gyi/ /lam bzang 'khrul med gzhan la legs bstan pa/ /ji srid 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho gnas kyi bar/ /'gro ba'i skyob par 'gyur bar byin gyis rlobs/ /sgrub dang sun 'byin gsal ba'i nyi 'od kyis/ /gzhan gzhung log smra'i mun pa kun bsal nas/ /yang dag don gyi pad mo kha bye ste/ /don gnyer bung ba skyong bar byin gyis rlobs/ /tshul 'di rigs lam brgyud pa la/ /dad pa'i bsod nams lus stobs rgyas/ /lta ngan log rtog kun sel ba/ /dam chos smra ba'i seng ges bsdebs/ /chu mo glang gi lo cho 'phrul chen po'i zla ba la sbyar ba 'di yongs su rdzogs so// //gang zhig dad pas bla ma'i tshogs rnams la/ /tshig 'dis rtag tu gsol ba 'debs byed na/ /de yi rgyud la smra mchog de dag gi /yang dag rigs pa'i snang ba 'jug par 'gyur/ /dge'o// // ༄/ rgyal tshab byams pa'i bstod pa bzhugs/ na ma ārya mai tri nā thā ya/ byams pa'i dkyil 'khor chos dbyings mkha' la 'char/ /mkhyen pa'i nyi 'od gdul bya pad mo'i gnyen/ /srid zhi'i mun pa stong gis ma pham pa/ /rgyal tshab chos kyi nyi ma de la 'dud/ /chags pa'i skyon bral pad mo'i lte bar ni/ /thugs rje'i cha shas yongs rdzogs zla gdan la/ /sems can don la dgyes pa'i sku mchog ni/

/gser bzang mdog can rnam par 'gying la 'dud/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas pa thugs khar ni/ /grangs med chos kyi sgo rnams 'byed pa'i tshul/ /phyag g.yon ting 'dzin bye ba rgyas mdzad pa'i/ /mnyam bzhag phyag rgyas bzhugs pa de la 'dud/ /rab mdzes pad mo'i lte bar spyi blugs kyi/ /ze'u 'bru rnam par rgyas pa'i rtse mor ni/ /zur phud lnga ldan lcang lo 'khyil ba yi/ /bung ba gzhon nu rol pa de la 'dud/ /bil ba ltar dmar mchu sgros yid 'ong zhing / /kha ba ltar dkar mdzod spu g.yas su 'khyil/ /mig sman ltar gnag ral pa'i thor cog ni/ /chos sku'i rten gyis mdzes par byas la 'dud/ /lang tsho'i dpal yon rgyas pa'i ljon pa la/ /mtshan gyi me tog dpe byad ze'u 'brus spras/ /rin chen mchog gi 'bras bu'i chun 'phyang can/ /sna tshogs dar gyi na bzas mdzes la 'dud/ /nyi ma 'bum gyi mdangs las gsal ba yi/ /rnam bkra 'od kyi 'phro 'du'i skad cig la/ /'gro ba'i las nyon tshang tshing kun bsal nas/ /ye shes snang ba rgyas par mdzad la 'dud/ /nye ring kun la snyoms pa tshangs pa'i dbyangs/ /thar lam ston pa lha yi rnga bo che/ /skye med 'gag pa med pa brag cha'i gsung / /yan lag drug cu'i dbyangs ldan de la 'dud/ /chos nyid dag pa gnyis ldan mngon du gyur/ /chos can ji snyed dbye ba so sor gzigs/ /chos rnams rnam kun mngon rdzogs byang chub pa/ /sgrib bral rnam par dag pa'i thugs la 'dud/ /stobs nyid rdo rje mi 'jigs seng ge bzhin/ /ma 'dres mkha' dag thub bstan chu zla ltar/ /bral dang rnam par smin pa'i 'bras bu yi/ /yon tan drug cu bzhis brgyan de la 'dud/ /brgya byin rnga sprin tshangs nyi yid bzhin nor/ /sgra brnyan nam mkha' sa bzhin srid mtha'i bar/ /'bad med lhun gyis grub pa'i mdzad pa ni/ /rgyun mi chad par 'jug pa de la 'dud/ /gus pas phyag 'tshal kun bzang mchod sprin 'bul/

/sdig pa kun bshags dge la rjes yi rang / /chos 'khor bskor zhing brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ /rab dkar dge tshogs byang chub chen por bsngo/ /dpag med yon tan gter mnga' mgon khyod la/ /mtha' med 'gro ba srid las bsgral ba'i phyir/ /yengs med rtse gcig yid kyis gsol 'debs kyi/ /dmigs med byams pa'i thugs kyis dgongs su gsol/ /khams gsum 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal rgyu bcas kun/ /dus gsum rtag tu bdag la blangs byas nas/ /sgo gsum 'bad pas bsags pa'i bde dge rnams/ /khams gsum 'gro la smin par byin gyis rlobs/ /pha rol phyin drug spyod pa'i go bgos nas/ /yang dag lta ba'i nyams myong gsal ba yi/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i gnas lugs mngon gyur te/ /bag chags spang phyir bsgom par byin gyis rlobs/ /sgrib gnyis sprin bral chos dbyings nam mkha' la/ /sku gsum nyin byed dkyil 'khor rab rgyas te/ /phrin las tsha zer phyogs bcur 'phro ba yis/ /'gro la lam bzang ston par byin gyis rlobs/ /gnas skabs kun tu mgon po khyod nyid kyi/ /gsung gi dgongs pa 'khrul med legs rtogs nas/ /lhag bsam dag pas phyogs bcur spel ba yis/ /theg mchog bstan pa rgyas par byin gyis rlobs/ /tshe 'di'i snang ba nub par gyur ma thag /dga' ldan gnas su thugs rje'i phyag gis drongs/ /ji srid sa rab dga' ba thob bar du/ /dam chos bdud rtsis tshim par byin gyis rlobs/ /mdor na sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /thugs kyi dgongs pa legs tshogs ji rnyed kun/ /bdag dang mkha' mnyam 'gro ba ma lus la/ /myur du 'grub par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /rgyal ba mi pham mgon po la bstod pa theg mchog gnad kyi sgo 'byed ces bya ba 'di ni khro phu'i byams chen la gsol ba 'debs pa'i don du bya bral ba bsod nams seng ges sbyar ba'o/ /dge'o// // ༄/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma'i bstod pa'o/

/na mo ārya tā re ye/ phun tshogs dngos grub gter chen rje btsun ma/ /spangs rtogs yongs rdzogs bde gshegs bcom ldan ma/ /mtha' med 'khor ba'i mtsho las sgrol mdzad ma/ /yi dam lha mo de la bdag skyabs mchi/ /lha dang lha min klu dbang cod pan la/ /gang gis zhabs pad bkod pa'i 'od zer gyi/ /phreng ba 'jig rten kun na rab mdzes ma/ /yi dam lha mo de la bdag skyabs mchi/ /rnam dag chos dbyings zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus/ /tāṃ yig las 'khrungs mar gad lta bu'i sku/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhi ba'i gzugs can ma/ /yi dam lha mo de la bdag skyabs mchi/ /phyag g.yas mchog sbyin 'gro la dngos grub ster/ /g.yon pa dkon mchog gsum mtshon phyag rgya yis/ /utpal yu ba thugs khar 'dzin mdzad ma/ /yi dam lha mo de la bdag skyabs mchi/ /thabs mkhas 'gro don la bzhengs zhabs g.yas brkyang / /shes rab gzung 'dzin rab spangs g.yon bskum gyis/ /mi 'bral mtshon phyir 'khril ba'i tshul mdzad ma/ /yi dam lha mo de la bdag skyabs mchi/ /skra 'khyil me tog gis brgyan mdzes pa'i dbu/ /cung zad yo ba'i thugs rje'i spyan zur gyis/ /mtha' dag 'gro la rtag tu gzigs mdzad ma/ /yi dam lha mo de la bdag skyabs mchi/ /rgyab yol zla ba la ni rgyab brten nas/ /'gying bag gzhon nu lang tsho 'gying mdzad cing / /rgyan mchog rin chen kun gyi rgyan ldan ma/ /yi dam lha mo de la bdag skyabs mchi/ /nu 'bur zung mdzes nyi zla lta bu ste/ /dri zhim ngad ldan ma la ya yi ri/ /utpal bsnams pas rdzing bu dang mtshungs ma/ /yi dam lha mo de la bdag skyabs mchi/ /bkra shis oṃ gyi nga ros rab drangs nas/ /skyob mdzad tā res 'jigs sgrol tuttā re/ /myur mgyogs tu re swā hā dang ldan ma/ /yi dam lha mo de la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sprin bral mkha' la rgyu ba'i nyi zer gyis/ /pad mo gzhon nu phye ba ji bzhin du/ /shes bya'i gnas la mkhyen pa rab rgyas ma/

/yi dam lha mo'i thugs la bdag skyabs mchi/ /'jig rten mgon po'i spyan chab las 'khrungs tshe/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba skyob pa'i don mdzad ces/ /dam bca' zhal bzhes bsnyel ba mi mnga' bar/ /bdag dang mkha' mnyam 'gro la bskyab tu gsol/ /stobs sogs yon tan kun gyi gter gyur pa/ /snying po yod kyang dri mas bsgribs gyur nas/ /yon tan 'byor bas dbul ba'i 'gro rnams la/ /thugs rje'i chu yis dri ma sbyang du gsol/ /bde nas bde bar 'gro ba'i lam mchog la/ /thos bsam tshul gyis nges pa rnyed gyur kyang / /bsgoms pa'i ro mchog myang bar ma gyur pa/ /dman pa bdag la nyams rtogs stsal du gsol/ /snyigs dus bde gshegs bstan pa 'dzin pa yi/ /phyi nang bar chad mtha' dag nyer zhi nas/ /rgyal bas bsngags pa'i mthun rkyen ma lus pa/ /'bad med lhun gyis grub par mdzad du gsol/ /tshe 'di'i snang ba nub par gyur ma thag /'od dpag med pa'i zhing mchog dam pa der/ /rje btsun sgrol ma'i drung du skyes nas kyang / /sa rab dga' ba thob par mdzad du gsol/ /rgyal yum sgrol ma la bstod pa dngos grub rgya mtsho zhes bya ba 'di ni gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi 'dod pa'i don zhu ba'i ched du shākya'i dge slong bsod nams seng ges lcags pho stag gi rgyal gyi nyi ma la dga' ba tshal gyi dgon par sbyar ba'o/ /dge'o// // ༄/ /chos skyong gi bstod pa bzhugs/ dpal sa skya'i bka' srung rnams la bstod pa rnam par rgyal ba'i rnga chen zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rab 'bar bskal pa'i me dpung klong dkyil na/ /rab 'jigs gzugs thung mdog nag cher 'bar zhing / /rab gsal spyan gsum me stag lta bur 'phros/ /rab gdangs zhal dmar rnam par g.yo la 'dud/ /shin tu rgyas pa'i phyag gnyis thugs khar ni/ /gri gug thod pa rnam 'phrul gaṇḍi bsnams/ /zlum po'i stabs kyis zhabs gnyis dgra bgegs kyi/

/snying khar brdabs pas sa gsum g.yo la 'dud/ /rab mdzes rin chen dar gyi cod paṇa bklubs/ /mi sdug sbrul dang rus pa'i rgyan cha 'khrol/ /'jigs rung khrag 'dzag mgo bo'i do shal byas/ /dpa' bo stag gi sham thabs can la bstod/ /rigs lnga'i ngo bo khyung chen nam mkhar spro/ /bya nag gshog bskor khyi nag 'khang zhing zug /lce spyang 'bros 'ded mi nag bshugs glu len/ /sprul pa'i pho nyas dgra bgegs sgrol la 'dud/ /ha ha 'dod khro rmongs pa'i grong khyer bsgyel/ /hūm̐ hūm̐ gzung 'dzin rtog pa'i brag ri bshig /phaṭa phaṭa bdud dang log 'dren snying rab 'gas/ /srid gsum skrag mdzad drag po'i gsung la 'dud/ /spros kun nyer zhi chos sku mngon gyur kyang / /gdug can zhi bas 'dul bar mi nus pa/ /rnam 'phrul drag pos 'dul ba'i thabs mkhyen nas/ /tshar gcod rjes 'dzin mnga' ba'i thugs la 'dud/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum gcig dpal ldan ma/ /spyan gsum ldan pa'i zhal gcig mche ba gtsigs/ /khams gsum zil gnon ral gcig g.yon du 'phyang / /srid gsum gso mdzad yum chen ma la 'dud/ /'dod khams zil gnon 'dod khams dbang phyug ma/ /mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor/ /khrag gi mtshor gnas khrag gi thig les brgyan/ /'jigs pa'i mtshon chas 'jigs rung ma la 'dud/ /zhal bzhi phrin las bzhi yis 'gro ba skyong / /mche ba bzhi yis bdud bzhi rnam par 'joms/ /phyag bzhi sna tshogs mtshon chas rgyud bzhi bsrung / /sring mo bzhi ldan gdong bzhi pa la 'dud/ /gnod sbyin yab yum bdud kyi mgo bo gcod/ /bka' sdod pu tra dgra bo'i klad khrag 'dren/ /'jigs byed bha ṭa dgra snying sbar gyis 'debs/ /bstan dgra sreg byed kha 'bar ma la 'dud/ /mgon po'i bka' nyan las mkhan ma rungs pa/ /bud med skyes pa dge slong sngags pa'i tshul/ /brgya phrag bzhi yis phyogs bzhi'i ru 'dren pa/

/sprul pa'i dmag tshogs rnams la bstod par bgyi/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang thugs kyi ye shes las/ /bka' bstod srung ma'i tshul du rnam sprul nas/ /bstan pa rin chen bang mdzod bsrung mdzad pa/ /dam can rgya mtsho 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /ting 'dzin sngags rgyas spel ba'i gtor ma dang / /dam rdzas spyan gzigs mchod pa 'di bzhes la/ /bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pas bka' bsgos ltar/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi/ /nad dang gdon dang gzhan gyi byad kha sogs/ /dam chos bsgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen kun zhi nas/ /tshe dang bsod nams 'khor dang longs spyod sogs/ /mthun rkyen ma lus phun sum tshogs par mdzod/ /bstan 'dzin thams cad sku tshe brtan pa dang / /bstan pa rin chen phyogs bcur rgyas pa dang / /bstan la gnod byed dgra bgegs 'dul ba dang / /bstan pas khyab pa'i 'gro rnams bde bar mdzod/ /dpal sa skya pa'i bka' srung rnams la bstod pa rnam par rgyal ba'i rnga chen zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rje btsun dam pa kun dga' bzang po yab sras kyi zhabs kyi pad mo la yan lag mchog gis reg pa shākya'i dge slong bsod nams seng ges rta nag gser gling gi dgon par sbyar ba'o// ༈ //'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sman gcig pu/ /bde ba thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ /bstan pa rnyed dang bkur sti dang / /bcas te yun ring gnas gyur cig/ //dge'o// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun mkhyen go bo rab 'byams pa/ kun mkhyen chen po'i bka' 'bum gyi po ti thog ma'i skabs las bstod tshogs kyi skor/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 3
